enum class CourseType(
    val code: String,
    val title: String,
    val shortCode: String,
    val wikiDomain: String,
    val defaultExplainLang: String // "ru" или "en"
) {
    EN("en", "English", "EN", "en.wikipedia.org", "ru"),
    UK("uk", "Українська", "UK", "uk.wikipedia.org", "ru"),
    PL("pl", "Polski", "PL", "pl.wikipedia.org", "ru"),
    RU("ru", "Русский", "RU", "ru.wikipedia.org", "en"),
    ISV("isv", "Межславянский", "ISV", "ru.wikipedia.org", "ru");

    companion object {
        fun fromCode(code: String): CourseType =
            entries.find { it.code == code } ?: EN
    }
}

enum class CefrLevel(val code: String, val orderIndex: Int) {
    A0("A0", 0),
    A1("A1", 1),
    A2("A2", 2),
    B1("B1", 3),
    B2("B2", 4),
    C1("C1", 5),
    C2("C2", 6);

    fun nextLevel(): CefrLevel? = entries.find { it.orderIndex == orderIndex + 1 }

    companion object {
        fun fromCode(code: String): CefrLevel =
            entries.find { it.code.equals(code.trim(), ignoreCase = true) } ?: A0
    }
}

/**
 * Слово курса. Интервалы повторов: 1, 3, 7, 14 и 30 дней.
 * step: 0 = Новое, 1 = 1д, 2 = 3д, 3 = 7д, 4 = 14д, 5 = 30д, 6 = Закреплено (больше в очередь не попадает).
 */
@Entity(tableName = "course_words")
data class WordEntity(
    @PrimaryKey val id: String,
    val courseCode: String,
    val level: String,
    val word: String,
    val pos: String,
    val ipa: String,
    val usWord: String,
    val translationsRu: String,
    val translationsEn: String,
    val example: String,
    val exampleTr: String,
    val equivalentsJson: String = "", // Для межславянского (ru, uk, pl, be, cs, sk, sl, hr, sr, bg, mk)
    val isUserAdded: Boolean = false,
    // Статус Anki:
    val step: Int = 0, // 0=Новое, 1..5=В повторении (1,3,7,14,30 дн.), 6=Закреплено
    val nextReviewEpochDay: Long = 0L,
    val lastReviewedEpochDay: Long = 0L,
    val introducedEpochDay: Long = 0L,
    val hadMistake: Boolean = false
) {
    companion object {
        val INTERVAL_DAYS = listOf(1, 3, 7, 14, 30)
        const val STEP_NEW = 0
        const val STEP_MASTERED = 6
    }

    val isNew: Boolean get() = step == STEP_NEW
    val isInReview: Boolean get() = step in 1..5
    val isMastered: Boolean get() = step >= STEP_MASTERED

    fun currentIntervalDays(): Int =
        if (step in 1..5) INTERVAL_DAYS[step - 1] else 0

    fun statusLabel(): String = when {
        isMastered -> "Закреплено"
        isInReview -> "В повторении (${currentIntervalDays()} дн.)"
        else -> "Новое"
    }

    fun displayWord(useUsEnglish: Boolean): String =
        if (courseCode == "en" && useUsEnglish && usWord.isNotBlank()) usWord else word

    fun acceptedTranslations(explainLang: String): String =
        if (explainLang == "en" && translationsEn.isNotBlank()) translationsEn
        else if (translationsRu.isNotBlank()) translationsRu
        else translationsEn
}

@Dao
interface V2Dao {
    @Query("SELECT * FROM course_words")
    fun observeAllWords(): Flow<List<WordEntity>>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM course_words")
    suspend fun getAllWordsOnce(): List<WordEntity>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insertWords(words: List<WordEntity>)

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insertWord(word: WordEntity)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM grammar_progress")
    fun observeGrammarProgress(): Flow<List<GrammarProgressEntity>>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM grammar_progress")
    suspend fun getGrammarProgressOnce(): List<GrammarProgressEntity>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun saveGrammarProgress(item: GrammarProgressEntity)

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun saveGrammarProgressList(items: List<GrammarProgressEntity>)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM course_state")
    fun observeCourseStates(): Flow<List<CourseStateEntity>>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM course_state")
    suspend fun getCourseStatesOnce(): List<CourseStateEntity>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun saveCourseState(state: CourseStateEntity)

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun saveCourseStates(states: List<CourseStateEntity>)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM study_sessions ORDER BY startTimeMillis DESC")
    fun observeSessions(): Flow<List<StudySessionEntity>>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM study_sessions")
    suspend fun getSessionsOnce(): List<StudySessionEntity>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insertSession(session: StudySessionEntity)

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insertSessions(sessions: List<StudySessionEntity>)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM used_test_questions")
    suspend fun getUsedQuestionsOnce(): List<UsedTestQuestionEntity>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insertUsedQuestions(items: List<UsedTestQuestionEntity>)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM unlocked_medals")
    fun observeUnlockedMedals(): Flow<List<UnlockedMedalEntity>>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM unlocked_medals")
    suspend fun getUnlockedMedalsOnce(): List<UnlockedMedalEntity>

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insertUnlockedMedal(medal: UnlockedMedalEntity)

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun insertUnlockedMedals(medals: List<UnlockedMedalEntity>)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM app_meta WHERE id = 1")
    fun observeMeta(): Flow<AppMetaEntity?>

    @Query("SELECT * FROM app_meta WHERE id = 1")
    suspend fun getMetaOnce(): AppMetaEntity?

    @Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)
    suspend fun saveMeta(meta: AppMetaEntity)

    @Query("DELETE FROM course_words")
    suspend fun clearWords()

    @Query("DELETE FROM grammar_progress")
    suspend fun clearGrammarProgress()

    @Query("DELETE FROM course_state")
    suspend fun clearCourseStates()

    @Query("DELETE FROM study_sessions")
    suspend fun clearSessions()

    @Query("DELETE FROM unlocked_medals")
    suspend fun clearMedals()
}

@Database(
    entities = [
        WordEntity::class,
        GrammarProgressEntity::class,
        CourseStateEntity::class,
        StudySessionEntity::class,
        UsedTestQuestionEntity::class,
        UnlockedMedalEntity::class,
        AppMetaEntity::class
    ],
    version = 2,
    exportSchema = false
)
abstract class V2Database : RoomDatabase() {
    abstract fun dao(): V2Dao

    companion object {
        @Volatile
        private var INSTANCE: V2Database? = null

        fun getInstance(context: Context): V2Database {
            return INSTANCE ?: synchronized(this) {
val instance = Room.databaseBuilder(
    context.applicationContext,
    V2Database::class.java,
    "lang_tracker_v2.db"
)
    .fallbackToDestructiveMigration() // Прогресс v1 не переносится по ТЗ (раздел 2)
    .build()
INSTANCE = instance
instance
            }
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 4. АЛГОРИТМ ПРОВЕРКИ ОТВЕТА В ANKI (ЛЕВЕНШТЕЙН, ДИАКРИТИКА PL, Е/Ё)
// ============================================================================

data class AnswerCheckResult(
    val isCorrect: Boolean,
    val matchedVariant: String,
    val note: String // "", "исправлено: ...", "правильно: ..."
)

object AnswerChecker {
    private val polishDiacriticsMap = mapOf(
        'ą' to 'a', 'ć' to 'c', 'ę' to 'e', 'ł' to 'l',
        'ń' to 'n', 'ó' to 'o', 'ś' to 's', 'ź' to 'z', 'ż' to 'z'
    )

    fun normalizeBasic(input: String): String {
        return input
            .lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
            .replace('ё', 'е')
            .map { if (it.isLetterOrDigit() || it.isWhitespace()) it else ' ' }.joinToString("")
            .replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ")
            .trim()
    }

    fun stripPolishDiacritics(input: String): String {
        val sb = StringBuilder(input.length)
        for (ch in input) {
            sb.append(polishDiacriticsMap[ch] ?: ch)
        }
        return sb.toString()
    }

    fun levenshtein(a: String, b: String): Int {
        if (a == b) return 0
        if (a.isEmpty()) return b.length
        if (b.isEmpty()) return a.length
        val prev = IntArray(b.length + 1) { it }
        val curr = IntArray(b.length + 1)
        for (i in 1..a.length) {
            curr[0] = i
            for (j in 1..b.length) {
val cost = if (a[i - 1] == b[j - 1]) 0 else 1
curr[j] = min(min(curr[j - 1] + 1, prev[j] + 1), prev[j - 1] + cost)
            }
            for (j in 0..b.length) prev[j] = curr[j]
        }
        return prev[b.length]
    }

    /**
     * Проверка ответа по правилам Раздела 5 ТЗ:
     * - Варианты разделены «|».
     * - Регистр, ё и е, лишние пробелы и знаки препинания не учитываются.
     * - Для польского ввод без диакритики (zolw вместо żółw) засчитывается с пометкой «правильно: żółw».
     * - Опечатка засчитывается как верная с пометкой «исправлено: …»:
     *   1 ошибка в словах от 5 букв (5..7), 2 ошибки — в словах от 8 букв (>=8).
     */
    fun check(userRaw: String, rawVariants: String): AnswerCheckResult {
        val userNorm = normalizeBasic(userRaw)
        if (userNorm.isEmpty()) {
            return AnswerCheckResult(false, "", "")
        }
        val variants = rawVariants.split("|")
            .map { it.trim() }
            .filter { it.isNotEmpty() }

        // 1. Точное совпадение (с учётом регистра, е/ё, пробелов и пунктуации)
        for (v in variants) {
            val vNorm = normalizeBasic(v)
            if (userNorm == vNorm) {
return AnswerCheckResult(true, v, "")
            }
        }

        // 2. Проверка польской диакритики (например zolw вместо żółw)
        for (v in variants) {
            val vNorm = normalizeBasic(v)
            if (stripPolishDiacritics(userNorm) == stripPolishDiacritics(vNorm) && userNorm != vNorm) {
return AnswerCheckResult(true, v, "правильно: $v")
            }
        }

        // 3. Проверка опечаток по расстоянию Левенштейна (1 ошибка от 5 букв, 2 — от 8 букв)
        var bestTypoMatch: String? = null
        var bestDist = Int.MAX_VALUE
        for (v in variants) {
            val vNorm = normalizeBasic(v)
            val len = vNorm.length
            val maxAllowedErrors = when {
len >= 8 -> 2
len >= 5 -> 1
else -> 0
            }
            if (maxAllowedErrors > 0) {
val dist = levenshtein(userNorm, vNorm)
if (dist in 1..maxAllowedErrors && dist < bestDist) {
    bestDist = dist
    bestTypoMatch = v
}
            }
        }
        if (bestTypoMatch != null) {
            return AnswerCheckResult(true, bestTypoMatch, "исправлено: $bestTypoMatch")
        }

        return AnswerCheckResult(false, variants.firstOrNull() ?: "", "")
    }
}

object StarterFilesBundle {
    private val zipChunks: List<String> = listOf(
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        ""
    )

    private fun decodeEntries(): Map<String, ByteArray> {
        val result = mutableMapOf<String, ByteArray>()
        val bytes = Base64.decode(zipChunks.joinToString(""), Base64.DEFAULT)
        java.util.zip.ZipInputStream(java.io.ByteArrayInputStream(bytes)).use { zis ->
            var entry = zis.nextEntry
            while (entry != null) {
if (!entry.isDirectory) {
    result[entry.name] = zis.readBytes()
}
zis.closeEntry()
entry = zis.nextEntry
            }
        }
        return result
    }

    fun writeStarterFilesToInternalDir(context: Context): File {
        val baseDir = File(context.filesDir, "data")
        for ((relPath, dataBytes) in decodeEntries()) {
            val target = File(baseDir, relPath)
            target.parentFile?.mkdirs()
            if (!target.exists()) {
target.writeBytes(dataBytes)
            }
        }
        return baseDir
    }

    fun writeStarterFilesToSafTree(context: Context, treeUri: Uri) {
        val rootDoc = DocumentFile.fromTreeUri(context, treeUri) ?: return
        for ((relPath, dataBytes) in decodeEntries()) {
            val parts = relPath.split("/")
            var currentDir = rootDoc
            for (i in 0 until parts.size - 1) {
val dirName = parts[i]
val nextDir = currentDir.findFile(dirName) ?: currentDir.createDirectory(dirName)
if (nextDir != null) currentDir = nextDir
            }
            val fileName = parts.last()
            if (currentDir.findFile(fileName) == null) {
val mime = when {
    fileName.endsWith(".csv") -> "text/csv"
    fileName.endsWith(".json") -> "application/json"
    fileName.endsWith(".webp") -> "image/webp"
    else -> "application/octet-stream"
}
val newFile = currentDir.createFile(mime, fileName)
if (newFile != null) {
    context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(newFile.uri)?.use { out ->
        out.write(dataBytes)
    }
}
            }
        }
    }
}

data class ParsedCourseData(
    val words: List<WordEntity>,
    val grammarUnits: List<GrammarUnitData>,
    val tests: List<TestQuestionData>,
    val texts: List<ReadingTextData>,
    val glossary: List<GlossaryEntry>,
    val skippedLinesReport: List<String>
)

object DataFolderParser {

    /**
     * Разбор строки CSV с разделителем ';' и поддержкой кавычек.
     */
    fun splitCsvSemicolon(line: String): List<String> {
        val result = mutableListOf<String>()
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        var inQuotes = false
        var i = 0
        while (i < line.length) {
            val ch = line[i]
            if (ch == '"') {
inQuotes = !inQuotes
            } else if (ch == ';' && !inQuotes) {
result.add(sb.toString().trim())
sb.setLength(0)
            } else {
sb.append(ch)
            }
            i++
        }
        result.add(sb.toString().trim())
        return result
    }

    fun parseAllCourses(
        context: Context,
        safUriStr: String,
        useInternal: Boolean,
        existingWordsById: Map<String, WordEntity>
    ): Map<String, ParsedCourseData> {
        val result = mutableMapOf<String, ParsedCourseData>()
        for (course in CourseType.entries) {
            result[course.code] = parseSingleCourse(
context = context,
courseCode = course.code,
safUriStr = safUriStr,
useInternal = useInternal,
existingWordsById = existingWordsById
            )
        }
        return result
    }

    private fun readFileText(
        context: Context,
        safUriStr: String,
        useInternal: Boolean,
        courseCode: String,
        fileName: String
    ): String? {
        return try {
            if (useInternal) {
val f = File(File(context.filesDir, "data/$courseCode"), fileName)
if (f.exists()) f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) else null
            } else if (safUriStr.isNotBlank()) {
val treeUri = Uri.parse(safUriStr)
val root = DocumentFile.fromTreeUri(context, treeUri) ?: return null
val dataRoot = root.findFile("data") ?: root
val courseDir = dataRoot.findFile(courseCode) ?: return null
val docFile = courseDir.findFile(fileName) ?: return null
context.contentResolver.openInputStream(docFile.uri)?.use { inp ->
    BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(inp, Charsets.UTF_8)).readText()
}
            } else null
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    fun loadWordBitmap(
        context: Context,
        safUriStr: String,
        useInternal: Boolean,
        wordId: String
    ): Bitmap? {
        return try {
            val candidates = listOf("$wordId.webp", "$wordId.png")
            if (useInternal) {
val imgDir = File(context.filesDir, "data/images")
for (name in candidates) {
    val f = File(imgDir, name)
    if (f.exists()) return BitmapFactory.decodeFile(f.absolutePath)
}
null
            } else if (safUriStr.isNotBlank()) {
val treeUri = Uri.parse(safUriStr)
val root = DocumentFile.fromTreeUri(context, treeUri) ?: return null
val dataRoot = root.findFile("data") ?: root
val imgDir = dataRoot.findFile("images") ?: return null
for (name in candidates) {
    val doc = imgDir.findFile(name)
    if (doc != null) {
        return context.contentResolver.openInputStream(doc.uri)?.use {
            BitmapFactory.decodeStream(it)
        }
    }
}
null
            } else null
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    fun appendUserWordToFile(
        context: Context,
        safUriStr: String,
        useInternal: Boolean,
        word: WordEntity
    ) {
        try {
            if (word.courseCode == "isv") {
val existingText = readFileText(context, safUriStr, useInternal, "isv", "words.json") ?: "[]"
val arr = JSONArray(existingText)
val obj = JSONObject().apply {
    put("id", word.id)
    put("level", word.level)
    put("isv", word.word)
    put("pos", word.pos)
    put("translations_ru", word.translationsRu)
    put("translations_en", word.translationsEn)
    put("equivalents", if (word.equivalentsJson.isNotBlank()) JSONObject(word.equivalentsJson) else JSONObject())
    put("example_isv", word.example)
    put("example_ru", word.exampleTr)
}
arr.put(obj)
writeCourseFileText(context, safUriStr, useInternal, "isv", "words.json", arr.toString(2))
            } else {
val existingText = readFileText(context, safUriStr, useInternal, word.courseCode, "words.csv")
    ?: "id;level;word;pos;ipa;us_word;translations_ru;translations_en;example;example_tr\n"
val newRow = listOf(
    word.id, word.level, word.word, word.pos, word.ipa,
    word.usWord, word.translationsRu, word.translationsEn,
    word.example, word.exampleTr
).joinToString(";")
val updated = existingText.trimEnd() + "\n" + newRow + "\n"
writeCourseFileText(context, safUriStr, useInternal, word.courseCode, "words.csv", updated)
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {
        }
    }

    private fun writeCourseFileText(
        context: Context,
        safUriStr: String,
        useInternal: Boolean,
        courseCode: String,
        fileName: String,
        content: String
    ) {
        try {
            if (useInternal) {
val dir = File(context.filesDir, "data/$courseCode")
dir.mkdirs()
File(dir, fileName).writeText(content, Charsets.UTF_8)
            } else if (safUriStr.isNotBlank()) {
val root = DocumentFile.fromTreeUri(context, Uri.parse(safUriStr)) ?: return
val dataRoot = root.findFile("data") ?: root
val courseDir = dataRoot.findFile(courseCode) ?: dataRoot.createDirectory(courseCode) ?: return
val docFile = courseDir.findFile(fileName)
    ?: courseDir.createFile("text/plain", fileName) ?: return
context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(docFile.uri, "wt")?.use { out ->
    out.write(content.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
}
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {
        }
    }

    private fun parseSingleCourse(
        context: Context,
        courseCode: String,
        safUriStr: String,
        useInternal: Boolean,
        existingWordsById: Map<String, WordEntity>
    ): ParsedCourseData {
        val skipped = mutableListOf<String>()
        val words = mutableListOf<WordEntity>()

        // 1. Слова: words.csv или words.json (для isv)
        if (courseCode == "isv") {
            val rawJson = readFileText(context, safUriStr, useInternal, "isv", "words.json")
            if (rawJson != null) {
try {
    val arr = JSONArray(rawJson)
    for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
        try {
            val obj = arr.getJSONObject(i)
            val id = obj.optString("id").trim()
            val lvl = obj.optString("level").trim()
            val isvWord = obj.optString("isv").trim()
            if (id.isEmpty() || isvWord.isEmpty() || lvl !in CefrLevel.entries.map { it.code }) {
                skipped.add("data/isv/words.json: запись #${i + 1}")
                continue
            }
            val prev = existingWordsById[id]
            val eqObj = obj.optJSONObject("equivalents") ?: JSONObject()
            words.add(
                WordEntity(
                    id = id,
                    courseCode = "isv",
                    level = lvl,
                    word = isvWord,
                    pos = obj.optString("pos", ""),
                    ipa = "",
                    usWord = "",
                    translationsRu = obj.optString("translations_ru", ""),
                    translationsEn = obj.optString("translations_en", ""),
                    example = obj.optString("example_isv", ""),
                    exampleTr = obj.optString("example_ru", ""),
                    equivalentsJson = eqObj.toString(),
                    isUserAdded = prev?.isUserAdded ?: false,
                    step = prev?.step ?: 0,
                    nextReviewEpochDay = prev?.nextReviewEpochDay ?: 0L,
                    lastReviewedEpochDay = prev?.lastReviewedEpochDay ?: 0L,
                    introducedEpochDay = prev?.introducedEpochDay ?: 0L,
                    hadMistake = prev?.hadMistake ?: false
                )
            )
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            skipped.add("data/isv/words.json: запись #${i + 1}")
        }
    }
} catch (_: Exception) {
    skipped.add("data/isv/words.json: ошибка формата JSON")
}
            }
        } else {
            val rawCsv = readFileText(context, safUriStr, useInternal, courseCode, "words.csv")
            if (rawCsv != null) {
val lines = rawCsv.lines()
for (lineIdx in 1 until lines.size) { // Первая строка — заголовки
    val line = lines[lineIdx].trim()
    if (line.isEmpty()) continue
    val cols = splitCsvSemicolon(line)
    if (cols.size < 10) {
        skipped.add("data/$courseCode/words.csv: строка ${lineIdx + 1}")
        continue
    }
    val id = cols[0]
    val lvl = cols[1]
    val w = cols[2]
    if (id.isEmpty() || w.isEmpty() || lvl !in CefrLevel.entries.map { it.code }) {
        skipped.add("data/$courseCode/words.csv: строка ${lineIdx + 1}")
        continue
    }
    val prev = existingWordsById[id]
    words.add(
        WordEntity(
            id = id,
            courseCode = courseCode,
            level = lvl,
            word = w,
            pos = cols[3],
            ipa = cols[4],
            usWord = cols[5],
            translationsRu = cols[6],
            translationsEn = cols[7],
            example = cols[8],
            exampleTr = cols[9],
            isUserAdded = prev?.isUserAdded ?: false,
            step = prev?.step ?: 0,
            nextReviewEpochDay = prev?.nextReviewEpochDay ?: 0L,
            lastReviewedEpochDay = prev?.lastReviewedEpochDay ?: 0L,
            introducedEpochDay = prev?.introducedEpochDay ?: 0L,
            hadMistake = prev?.hadMistake ?: false
        )
    )
}
            }
        }

        // 2. Грамматика: grammar.json
        val grammarUnits = mutableListOf<GrammarUnitData>()
        val rawGrammar = readFileText(context, safUriStr, useInternal, courseCode, "grammar.json")
        if (rawGrammar != null) {
            try {
val arr = JSONArray(rawGrammar)
for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
    try {
        val obj = arr.getJSONObject(i)
        val exArr = obj.optJSONArray("examples") ?: JSONArray()
        val examples = mutableListOf<GrammarExample>()
        for (j in 0 until exArr.length()) {
            val exObj = exArr.getJSONObject(j)
            examples.add(GrammarExample(exObj.optString("text"), exObj.optString("tr")))
        }
        val qArr = obj.optJSONArray("quiz") ?: JSONArray()
        val quiz = mutableListOf<QuizItem>()
        for (j in 0 until qArr.length()) {
            val qObj = qArr.getJSONObject(j)
            val optsArr = qObj.optJSONArray("options") ?: JSONArray()
            val opts = (0 until optsArr.length()).map { optsArr.getString(it) }
            quiz.add(
                QuizItem(
                    question = qObj.optString("question"),
                    options = opts,
                    answer = qObj.optString("answer"),
                    rule = qObj.optString("rule")
                )
            )
        }
        grammarUnits.add(
            GrammarUnitData(
                id = obj.getString("id"),
                courseCode = courseCode,
                level = obj.getString("level"),
                number = obj.optInt("number", i + 1),
                title = obj.getString("title"),
                rule = obj.getString("rule"),
                formula = obj.optString("formula", ""),
                examples = examples,
                commonMistake = obj.optString("common_mistake", ""),
                quiz = quiz
            )
        )
    } catch (_: Exception) {
        skipped.add("data/$courseCode/grammar.json: элемент #${i + 1}")
    }
}
            } catch (_: Exception) {
skipped.add("data/$courseCode/grammar.json: ошибка JSON")
            }
        }

        // 3. Тесты: tests.json
        val tests = mutableListOf<TestQuestionData>()
        val rawTests = readFileText(context, safUriStr, useInternal, courseCode, "tests.json")
        if (rawTests != null) {
            try {
val arr = JSONArray(rawTests)
for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
    try {
        val obj = arr.getJSONObject(i)
        val optsArr = obj.optJSONArray("options") ?: JSONArray()
        val opts = (0 until optsArr.length()).map { optsArr.getString(it) }
        tests.add(
            TestQuestionData(
                id = obj.getString("id"),
                courseCode = courseCode,
                level = obj.getString("level"),
                section = obj.getString("section"),
                type = obj.optString("type", "choice"),
                question = obj.getString("question"),
                options = opts,
                answer = obj.getString("answer"),
                rule = obj.optString("rule", "")
            )
        )
    } catch (_: Exception) {
        skipped.add("data/$courseCode/tests.json: вопрос #${i + 1}")
    }
}
            } catch (_: Exception) {
skipped.add("data/$courseCode/tests.json: ошибка JSON")
            }
        }

        // 4. Тексты: texts.json
        val texts = mutableListOf<ReadingTextData>()
        val rawTexts = readFileText(context, safUriStr, useInternal, courseCode, "texts.json")
        if (rawTexts != null) {
            try {
val arr = JSONArray(rawTexts)
for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
    try {
        val obj = arr.getJSONObject(i)
        val qArr = obj.optJSONArray("questions") ?: JSONArray()
        val qs = mutableListOf<QuizItem>()
        for (j in 0 until qArr.length()) {
            val qObj = qArr.getJSONObject(j)
            val optsArr = qObj.optJSONArray("options") ?: JSONArray()
            val opts = (0 until optsArr.length()).map { optsArr.getString(it) }
            qs.add(
                QuizItem(
                    question = qObj.optString("question"),
                    options = opts,
                    answer = qObj.optString("answer"),
                    rule = qObj.optString("rule")
                )
            )
        }
        texts.add(
            ReadingTextData(
                id = obj.getString("id"),
                courseCode = courseCode,
                level = obj.getString("level"),
                title = obj.getString("title"),
                text = obj.getString("text"),
                questions = qs
            )
        )
    } catch (_: Exception) {
        skipped.add("data/$courseCode/texts.json: текст #${i + 1}")
    }
}
            } catch (_: Exception) {
skipped.add("data/$courseCode/texts.json: ошибка JSON")
            }
        }

        // 5. Глоссарий: glossary.json
        val glossary = mutableListOf<GlossaryEntry>()
        val rawGlossary = readFileText(context, safUriStr, useInternal, courseCode, "glossary.json")
        if (rawGlossary != null) {
            try {
val arr = JSONArray(rawGlossary)
for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
    val obj = arr.getJSONObject(i)
    glossary.add(
        GlossaryEntry(
            term = obj.getString("term"),
            explanation = obj.getString("explanation"),
            example = obj.optString("example", "")
        )
    )
}
            } catch (_: Exception) {
skipped.add("data/$courseCode/glossary.json: ошибка JSON")
            }
        }

        return ParsedCourseData(
            words = words,
            grammarUnits = grammarUnits,
            tests = tests,
            texts = texts,
            glossary = glossary,
            skippedLinesReport = skipped
        )
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 6. НАПОМИНАНИЯ ЧЕРЕЗ WORKMANAGER (РАЗДЕЛ 16)
// ============================================================================

class DailyReminderWorker(
    appContext: Context,
    workerParams: WorkerParameters
) : CoroutineWorker(appContext, workerParams) {

    override suspend fun doWork(): Result {
        val db = V2Database.getInstance(applicationContext)
        val dao = db.dao()
        val meta = dao.getMetaOnce() ?: return Result.success()
        if (!meta.remindersEnabled) return Result.success()

        val today = LocalDate.now().toEpochDay()
        val states = dao.getCourseStatesOnce().filter { it.enabled }
        val allWords = dao.getAllWordsOnce()

        val duePerCourse = mutableListOf<String>()
        var totalDue = 0
        for (st in states) {
            val due = allWords.count {
it.courseCode == st.courseCode && it.isInReview && it.nextReviewEpochDay <= today
            }
            if (due > 0) {
totalDue += due
duePerCourse.add("${st.courseCode.uppercase()} $due")
            }
        }

        val testDueCourses = states.filter {
            it.placementCompleted && it.nextTestAvailableEpochDay <= today
        }.map { CourseType.fromCode(it.courseCode).title }

        if (totalDue == 0 && testDueCourses.isEmpty()) {
            // Если на сегодня ничего нет, напоминание не отправляется (Раздел 16)
            return Result.success()
        }

        val nm = applicationContext.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
        val channelId = "lang_v2_reminders"
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            nm.createNotificationChannel(
NotificationChannel(channelId, "Напоминания о повторах и тестах", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT)
            )
        }

        val textLines = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (totalDue > 0) {
            textLines.add("Повторы на сегодня: $totalDue (${duePerCourse.joinToString(", ")})")
        }
        if (testDueCourses.isNotEmpty()) {
            textLines.add("Доступен тест недели: ${testDueCourses.joinToString(", ")}")
        }

        val notification = NotificationCompat.Builder(applicationContext, channelId)
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_dialog_info)
            .setContentTitle("Пора позаниматься языками")
            .setContentText(textLines.joinToString(" • "))
            .setAutoCancel(true)
            .build()

        nm.notify(2001, notification)
        return Result.success()
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 7. СОСТОЯНИЯ АКТИВНЫХ ТЕСТОВ И РАЗБОРА ОШИБОК (РАЗДЕЛЫ 9, 10)
// ============================================================================

data class MistakeRecord(
    val question: String,
    val userAnswer: String,
    val correctAnswer: String,
    val rule: String
)

data class ErrorReviewState(
    val title: String,
    val subtitle: String,
    val nextStepHint: String,
    val passed: Boolean,
    val scorePercent: Int,
    val mistakes: List<MistakeRecord>
)

data class WeeklyTestSession(
    val courseCode: String,
    val targetLevel: String,
    val questions: List<TestQuestionData>,
    val currentIndex: Int = 0,
    val remainingSeconds: Int = 40 * 60, // До 40 минут
    val answers: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
    val mistakes: List<MistakeRecord> = emptyList()
)

data class PlacementTestSession(
    val courseCode: String,
    val currentLevel: CefrLevel = CefrLevel.A1,
    val levelQuestions: List<TestQuestionData>,
    val currentIndex: Int = 0,
    val correctInCurrentLevel: Int = 0,
    val lastPassedLevel: CefrLevel = CefrLevel.A0,
    val mistakes: List<MistakeRecord> = emptyList()
)

data class MedalViewItem(
    val id: String,
    val title: String,
    val conditionText: String,
    val progressText: String,
    val progressFraction: Float,
    val isUnlocked: Boolean,
    val category: String // "STREAK", "TIME", "LEVEL"
)

// ============================================================================
// 8. ГЛАВНАЯ VIEWMODEL v2
// ============================================================================

class V2ViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    private val db = V2Database.getInstance(application)
    private val dao = db.dao()

    val metaFlow: StateFlow<AppMetaEntity> = dao.observeMeta()
        .map { it ?: AppMetaEntity() }
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), AppMetaEntity())

    val wordsFlow: StateFlow<List<WordEntity>> = dao.observeAllWords()
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), emptyList())

    val grammarProgressFlow: StateFlow<List<GrammarProgressEntity>> = dao.observeGrammarProgress()
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), emptyList())

    val courseStatesFlow: StateFlow<List<CourseStateEntity>> = dao.observeCourseStates()
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), emptyList())

    val sessionsFlow: StateFlow<List<StudySessionEntity>> = dao.observeSessions()
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), emptyList())

    val unlockedMedalsFlow: StateFlow<List<UnlockedMedalEntity>> = dao.observeUnlockedMedals()
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), emptyList())

    // Контент из файлов данных (grammar.json, tests.json, texts.json, glossary.json)
    private val _parsedCourses = MutableStateFlow<Map<String, ParsedCourseData>>(emptyMap())
    val parsedCourses: StateFlow<Map<String, ParsedCourseData>> = _parsedCourses.asStateFlow()

    // Текущий активный тест недели (сохраняется при выходе с экрана теста, пока не истечёт время)
    private val _weeklyTestMap = MutableStateFlow<Map<String, WeeklyTestSession>>(emptyMap())
    val weeklyTestMap: StateFlow<Map<String, WeeklyTestSession>> = _weeklyTestMap.asStateFlow()

    private val _isWeeklyTestScreenOpen = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isWeeklyTestScreenOpen: StateFlow<Boolean> = _isWeeklyTestScreenOpen.asStateFlow()

    // Стартовый тест
    private val _placementSession = MutableStateFlow<PlacementTestSession?>(null)
    val placementSession: StateFlow<PlacementTestSession?> = _placementSession.asStateFlow()

    // Разбор ошибок после любого теста или мини-теста
    private val _errorReviewState = MutableStateFlow<ErrorReviewState?>(null)
    val errorReviewState: StateFlow<ErrorReviewState?> = _errorReviewState.asStateFlow()

    // Автоучёт времени (Раздел 13: без ручного таймера, пауза через 2 минуты бездействия или при сворачивании)
    private var isAppInForeground = true
    private var lastUserInteractionMillis = System.currentTimeMillis()
    private var currentActiveTabName = "PROGRESS"
    private var currentSessionCourse = "en"
    private var currentSessionStartMillis = System.currentTimeMillis()
    private var currentSessionAccumulatedSec = 0

    init {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val existingMeta = dao.getMetaOnce()
            if (existingMeta == null) {
dao.saveMeta(AppMetaEntity())
            }
            val existingStates = dao.getCourseStatesOnce()
            if (existingStates.isEmpty()) {
val initialStates = CourseType.entries.map { c ->
    CourseStateEntity(
        courseCode = c.code,
        enabled = true,
        currentLevel = "A0",
        placementCompleted = false,
        dailyNewLimit = 10,
        explainLang = c.defaultExplainLang
    )
}
dao.saveCourseStates(initialStates)
            }
            reloadDataFiles()
            recalculateStreakAndMedals()
        }

        // Фоновый цикл автоучёта времени (1 тик в секунду) и обратного отсчёта открытого Теста недели
        viewModelScope.launch {
            while (true) {
delay(1000L)
val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
val idleMillis = now - lastUserInteractionMillis
val isActive = isAppInForeground && idleMillis <= 120_000L // 2 минуты бездействия = пауза

if (isActive) {
    val meta = metaFlow.value
    val targetBucket = if (currentActiveTabName == "PROFILE") {
        "ALL_ONLY" // Профиль и настройки входят только в общее время (Раздел 13)
    } else {
        meta.activeCourseCode
    }

    if (targetBucket != currentSessionCourse && currentSessionAccumulatedSec > 0) {
        flushCurrentStudySession()
        currentSessionCourse = targetBucket
        currentSessionStartMillis = now
    } else if (currentSessionAccumulatedSec == 0) {
        currentSessionCourse = targetBucket
        currentSessionStartMillis = now
    }

    currentSessionAccumulatedSec += 1
    // Каждые 15 секунд сохраняем накопленную сессию в БД, чтобы часы в профиле обновлялись в реальном времени
    if (currentSessionAccumulatedSec >= 15) {
        flushCurrentStudySession()
        currentSessionStartMillis = now
    }
}

// Обратный отсчёт Теста недели идёт ТОЛЬКО пока экран теста открыт (Раздел 9)
if (isAppInForeground && _isWeeklyTestScreenOpen.value) {
    val activeCode = metaFlow.value.activeCourseCode
    val currentTest = _weeklyTestMap.value[activeCode]
    if (currentTest != null) {
        if (currentTest.remainingSeconds > 1) {
            _weeklyTestMap.value = _weeklyTestMap.value.toMutableMap().apply {
                put(activeCode, currentTest.copy(remainingSeconds = currentTest.remainingSeconds - 1))
            }
        } else {
            // Время вышло — завершаем тест
            finishWeeklyTest(activeCode)
        }
    }
}
            }
        }
    }

    fun onUserInteraction() {
        lastUserInteractionMillis = System.currentTimeMillis()
    }

    fun onAppForegroundChanged(inForeground: Boolean) {
        isAppInForeground = inForeground
        if (inForeground) {
            lastUserInteractionMillis = System.currentTimeMillis()
        } else {
            viewModelScope.launch {
flushCurrentStudySession()
            }
        }
    }

    fun onTabSelected(tabName: String) {
        onUserInteraction()
        if (currentActiveTabName != tabName) {
            viewModelScope.launch {
flushCurrentStudySession()
currentActiveTabName = tabName
currentSessionStartMillis = System.currentTimeMillis()
            }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun flushCurrentStudySession() {
        val sec = currentSessionAccumulatedSec
        if (sec <= 0) return
        currentSessionAccumulatedSec = 0
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val today = LocalDate.now().toEpochDay()
        dao.insertSession(
            StudySessionEntity(
courseCode = currentSessionCourse,
startTimeMillis = currentSessionStartMillis,
endTimeMillis = now,
durationSeconds = sec,
epochDay = today
            )
        )
        recalculateStreakAndMedals()
    }

    /**
     * Чтение файлов данных из выбранной папки (или встроенного стартового набора).
     */
    fun reloadDataFiles() {
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val meta = dao.getMetaOnce() ?: AppMetaEntity()
            if (meta.dataFolderUri.isBlank() && !meta.useInternalStarterFolder) {
return@launch
            }
            val existingWords = dao.getAllWordsOnce().associateBy { it.id }
            val parsed = DataFolderParser.parseAllCourses(
context = getApplication(),
safUriStr = meta.dataFolderUri,
useInternal = meta.useInternalStarterFolder,
existingWordsById = existingWords
            )
            _parsedCourses.value = parsed

            // Синхронизируем слова из файлов с таблицей Room (сохраняя статус повторов и пользовательские слова)
            val allFileWords = parsed.values.flatMap { it.words }
            val userOnlyWords = existingWords.values.filter {
it.isUserAdded && allFileWords.none { fw -> fw.id == it.id }
            }
            dao.insertWords(allFileWords + userOnlyWords)
        }
    }

    fun setSafDataFolder(uri: Uri, populateStarterFiles: Boolean) {
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val ctx = getApplication<Application>()
            try {
ctx.contentResolver.takePersistableUriPermission(
    uri,
    Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION or Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION
)
            } catch (_: Exception) {
            }
            if (populateStarterFiles) {
StarterFilesBundle.writeStarterFilesToSafTree(ctx, uri)
            }
            val meta = dao.getMetaOnce() ?: AppMetaEntity()
            dao.saveMeta(meta.copy(dataFolderUri = uri.toString(), useInternalStarterFolder = false))
            reloadDataFiles()
        }
    }

    fun activateInternalStarterFolder() {
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val ctx = getApplication<Application>()
            StarterFilesBundle.writeStarterFilesToInternalDir(ctx)
            val meta = dao.getMetaOnce() ?: AppMetaEntity()
            dao.saveMeta(meta.copy(useInternalStarterFolder = true))
            reloadDataFiles()
        }
    }

    fun switchCourse(courseCode: String) {
        onUserInteraction()
        viewModelScope.launch {
            flushCurrentStudySession()
            val meta = dao.getMetaOnce() ?: AppMetaEntity()
            dao.saveMeta(meta.copy(activeCourseCode = courseCode))
            currentSessionCourse = courseCode
            currentSessionStartMillis = System.currentTimeMillis()
        }
    }

    /**
     * Очередь Anki для активного курса (Раздел 5):
     * - Сначала повторы на сегодня, потом новые слова.
     * - Лимит новых слов в день отдельно для каждого курса (по умолчанию 10, от 0 до 30).
     * - Если в курсе накопилось > 50 повторов, новые слова не добавляются, пока очередь повторов не станет < 20.
     */
    fun getAnkiQueueForCourse(
        courseCode: String,
        levelFilter: String?,
        allWords: List<WordEntity>,
        courseState: CourseStateEntity
    ): List<WordEntity> {
        val today = LocalDate.now().toEpochDay()
        val courseWords = allWords.filter { it.courseCode == courseCode }

        val allDueReviews = courseWords.filter { it.isInReview && it.nextReviewEpochDay <= today }
        val dueReviewsCount = allDueReviews.size

        // Проверка блокировки перегрузки (>50 повторов блокирует новые слова до снижения <20)
        val isOverloaded = when {
            dueReviewsCount > 50 -> true
            courseState.overloadLocked && dueReviewsCount >= 20 -> true
            else -> false
        }
        if (isOverloaded != courseState.overloadLocked) {
            viewModelScope.launch {
dao.saveCourseState(courseState.copy(overloadLocked = isOverloaded))
            }
        }

        val introducedToday = courseWords.count { it.introducedEpochDay == today }
        val remainingNewQuota = if (isOverloaded || courseState.dailyNewLimit <= 0) {
            0
        } else {
            max(0, courseState.dailyNewLimit - introducedToday)
        }

        val filteredReviews = allDueReviews
            .filter { levelFilter == null || it.level == levelFilter }
            .sortedBy { it.nextReviewEpochDay }

        val filteredNew = courseWords
            .filter { it.isNew && (levelFilter == null || it.level == levelFilter) }
            .take(remainingNewQuota)

        return filteredReviews + filteredNew
    }

    /**
     * Сохранение результата ответа в Anki (Раздел 5):
     * Интервалы: 1, 3, 7, 14, 30 дней.
     * После верного повтора через 30 дней (step == 5) слово получает статус Закреплено (step = 6).
     * Ошибка или «Не помню» возвращает слово через 1 день (step = 1).
     */
    fun submitAnkiAnswer(word: WordEntity, isCorrect: Boolean) {
        onUserInteraction()
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val today = LocalDate.now().toEpochDay()
            val introDay = if (word.introducedEpochDay == 0L) today else word.introducedEpochDay
            val updated = if (isCorrect) {
val nextStep = (word.step + 1).coerceAtMost(WordEntity.STEP_MASTERED)
val interval = if (nextStep in 1..5) WordEntity.INTERVAL_DAYS[nextStep - 1] else 0
word.copy(
    step = nextStep,
    lastReviewedEpochDay = today,
    nextReviewEpochDay = if (nextStep == WordEntity.STEP_MASTERED) Long.MAX_VALUE else today + interval,
    introducedEpochDay = introDay
)
            } else {
word.copy(
    step = 1, // Возврат через 1 день
    lastReviewedEpochDay = today,
    nextReviewEpochDay = today + 1,
    introducedEpochDay = introDay,
    hadMistake = true
)
            }
            dao.insertWord(updated)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Добавление собственного слова через «+» в Словаре или тап по слову в Тексте.
     * Слово сразу попадает в очередь Anki своего курса как новое.
     */
    fun addCustomWord(
        courseCode: String,
        level: String,
        wordText: String,
        translationText: String,
        exampleText: String
    ) {
        onUserInteraction()
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val meta = dao.getMetaOnce() ?: AppMetaEntity()
            val state = dao.getCourseStatesOnce().find { it.courseCode == courseCode }
            val explainLang = state?.explainLang ?: CourseType.fromCode(courseCode).defaultExplainLang
            val newId = "USR_${courseCode.uppercase()}_${System.currentTimeMillis() % 100000}"
            val entity = WordEntity(
id = newId,
courseCode = courseCode,
level = level,
word = wordText.trim(),
pos = "word",
ipa = "",
usWord = "",
translationsRu = if (explainLang == "ru") translationText.trim() else "",
translationsEn = if (explainLang == "en") translationText.trim() else translationText.trim(),
example = exampleText.trim(),
exampleTr = "",
isUserAdded = true,
step = WordEntity.STEP_NEW
            )
            dao.insertWord(entity)
            DataFolderParser.appendUserWordToFile(
context = getApplication(),
safUriStr = meta.dataFolderUri,
useInternal = meta.useInternalStarterFolder,
word = entity
            )
        }
    }

    fun sendTextWordToAnki(courseCode: String, rawWord: String, translation: String, level: String) {
        onUserInteraction()
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val clean = AnswerChecker.normalizeBasic(rawWord)
            val existing = dao.getAllWordsOnce().find {
it.courseCode == courseCode && AnswerChecker.normalizeBasic(it.word) == clean
            }
            val today = LocalDate.now().toEpochDay()
            if (existing != null) {
dao.insertWord(
    existing.copy(
        step = 1,
        nextReviewEpochDay = today,
        introducedEpochDay = if (existing.introducedEpochDay == 0L) today else existing.introducedEpochDay
    )
)
            } else {
addCustomWord(courseCode, level, clean, translation, "")
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Завершение мини-теста по юниту грамматики (5 вопросов, засчитан при >= 4 верных).
     */
    fun submitGrammarQuizResult(
        courseCode: String,
        unit: GrammarUnitData,
        correctCount: Int,
        mistakes: List<MistakeRecord>
    ) {
        onUserInteraction()
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val passed = correctCount >= 4
            val existing = dao.getGrammarProgressOnce().find {
it.courseCode == courseCode && it.unitId == unit.id
            }
            dao.saveGrammarProgress(
GrammarProgressEntity(
    courseCode = courseCode,
    unitId = unit.id,
    isCompleted = passed || (existing?.isCompleted == true),
    needsRepeat = !passed
)
            )
            val pct = ((correctCount / 5f) * 100).roundToInt()
            _errorReviewState.value = ErrorReviewState(
title = if (passed) "Юнит засчитан ($correctCount из 5)" else "Нужно повторить ($correctCount из 5)",
subtitle = unit.title,
nextStepHint = if (passed) "Переходите к следующему юниту или тексту." else "Разберите ошибки ниже и попробуйте снова.",
passed = passed,
scorePercent = pct,
mistakes = mistakes
            )
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // СТАРТОВЫЙ ТЕСТ (РАЗДЕЛ 10: ПО 5 ВОПРОСОВ С A1 ДО ПЕРВОЙ ОСЕЧКИ < 4/5)
    // ========================================================================

    fun startPlacementTest(courseCode: String) {
        onUserInteraction()
        val courseData = _parsedCourses.value[courseCode] ?: return
        val a1Questions = buildPlacementQuestionsForLevel(courseData, CefrLevel.A1)
        if (a1Questions.isEmpty()) return
        _placementSession.value = PlacementTestSession(
            courseCode = courseCode,
            currentLevel = CefrLevel.A1,
            levelQuestions = a1Questions
        )
    }

    private fun buildPlacementQuestionsForLevel(courseData: ParsedCourseData, level: CefrLevel): List<TestQuestionData> {
        val fromTests = courseData.tests.filter { it.level == level.code }
        val fromGrammar = courseData.grammarUnits
            .filter { it.level == level.code }
            .flatMap { u ->
u.quiz.mapIndexed { idx, q ->
    TestQuestionData(
        id = "${u.id}_PQ_$idx",
        courseCode = u.courseCode,
        level = level.code,
        section = "grammar",
        type = "choice",
        question = q.question,
        options = q.options,
        answer = q.answer,
        rule = q.rule
    )
}
            }
        return (fromTests + fromGrammar).distinctBy { it.id }.take(5)
    }

    fun answerPlacementQuestion(userAnswer: String) {
        onUserInteraction()
        val session = _placementSession.value ?: return
        val q = session.levelQuestions.getOrNull(session.currentIndex) ?: return
        val isCorrect = AnswerChecker.check(userAnswer, q.answer).isCorrect
        val newCorrect = session.correctInCurrentLevel + (if (isCorrect) 1 else 0)
        val newMistakes = if (isCorrect) session.mistakes else {
            session.mistakes + MistakeRecord(q.question, userAnswer, q.answer, q.rule)
        }

        if (session.currentIndex + 1 < session.levelQuestions.size) {
            _placementSession.value = session.copy(
currentIndex = session.currentIndex + 1,
correctInCurrentLevel = newCorrect,
mistakes = newMistakes
            )
        } else {
            // Завершили 5 вопросов уровня
            val passedLevel = newCorrect >= 4
            val nextLvl = session.currentLevel.nextLevel()
            val courseData = _parsedCourses.value[session.courseCode]
            val nextQuestions = if (passedLevel && nextLvl != null && courseData != null) {
buildPlacementQuestionsForLevel(courseData, nextLvl)
            } else emptyList()

            if (passedLevel && nextLvl != null && nextQuestions.size >= 5) {
// Переходим к проверке следующего уровня
_placementSession.value = session.copy(
    currentLevel = nextLvl,
    levelQuestions = nextQuestions,
    currentIndex = 0,
    correctInCurrentLevel = 0,
    lastPassedLevel = session.currentLevel,
    mistakes = newMistakes
)
            } else {
// Остановка стартового теста
val finalLevel = if (passedLevel) session.currentLevel else session.lastPassedLevel
finalizePlacementTest(session.courseCode, finalLevel, newMistakes)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun finalizePlacementTest(
        courseCode: String,
        assignedLevel: CefrLevel,
        mistakes: List<MistakeRecord>
    ) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val today = LocalDate.now().toEpochDay()
            val states = dao.getCourseStatesOnce()
            val st = states.find { it.courseCode == courseCode } ?: CourseStateEntity(courseCode = courseCode)
            dao.saveCourseState(
st.copy(
    currentLevel = assignedLevel.code,
    placementCompleted = true,
    lastTestEpochDay = today,
    nextTestAvailableEpochDay = today + 7 // Первый тест недели через 7 дней после стартового
)
            )
            // Если стартовый тест определил уровень >= A1, открываем медали пройденных уровней
            for (lvl in CefrLevel.entries) {
if (lvl.orderIndex in 1..assignedLevel.orderIndex) {
    dao.insertUnlockedMedal(
        UnlockedMedalEntity("MEDAL_LVL_${courseCode}_${lvl.code}", today)
    )
}
            }
            applyTestMistakesConsequences(courseCode, assignedLevel.code, mistakes)
            _placementSession.value = null
            _errorReviewState.value = ErrorReviewState(
title = "Стартовый уровень: ${assignedLevel.code}",
subtitle = "Курс: ${CourseType.fromCode(courseCode).title}",
nextStepHint = "Следующий шаг: начните учить слова уровня ${assignedLevel.nextLevel()?.code ?: assignedLevel.code} в Anki и пройдите первый юнит грамматики.",
passed = true,
scorePercent = 100,
mistakes = mistakes
            )
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // ТЕСТ НЕДЕЛИ (РАЗДЕЛ 9: ДО 40 МИНУТ, 3 РАЗДЕЛА, ПОРОГ 75% И 60%)
    // ========================================================================

    fun openOrResumeWeeklyTest(courseCode: String) {
        onUserInteraction()
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val existing = _weeklyTestMap.value[courseCode]
            if (existing != null) {
_isWeeklyTestScreenOpen.value = true
return@launch
            }
            val states = dao.getCourseStatesOnce()
            val st = states.find { it.courseCode == courseCode } ?: return@launch
            val currentLvl = CefrLevel.fromCode(st.currentLevel)
            val targetLvl = currentLvl.nextLevel() ?: CefrLevel.C2

            val courseData = _parsedCourses.value[courseCode] ?: return@launch
            val today = LocalDate.now().toEpochDay()
            val recentlyUsedIds = dao.getUsedQuestionsOnce()
.filter { it.courseCode == courseCode && (today - it.usedEpochDay) <= 28L }
.map { it.questionId }
.toSet()

            // Собираем банк вопросов целевого уровня (без повторов за последние 4 недели)
            val levelBank = courseData.tests.filter {
it.level == targetLvl.code && it.id !in recentlyUsedIds
            }
            val readingQuestions = courseData.texts
.filter { it.level == targetLvl.code }
.take(2)
.flatMapIndexed { tIdx, txt ->
    txt.questions.mapIndexed { qIdx, q ->
        TestQuestionData(
            id = "${txt.id}_RQ_${tIdx}_$qIdx",
            courseCode = courseCode,
            level = targetLvl.code,
            section = "reading",
            type = "choice",
            question = "Текст «${txt.title}»:\n${txt.text}\n\nВопрос: ${q.question}",
            options = q.options,
            answer = q.answer,
            rule = q.rule
        )
    }
}
.filter { it.id !in recentlyUsedIds }

            val grammarSecName = if (courseCode == "isv") "cognates" else "grammar"
            val grammarQs = levelBank.filter { it.section == grammarSecName }.take(20)
            val vocabQs = levelBank.filter { it.section == "vocab" }.take(25)
            val readingQs = (levelBank.filter { it.section == "reading" } + readingQuestions)
.distinctBy { it.id }
.take(10)

            val combined = grammarQs + vocabQs + readingQs
            if (combined.isEmpty()) {
// Если банк пуст, тест не открывается (Раздел 9)
return@launch
            }

            val session = WeeklyTestSession(
courseCode = courseCode,
targetLevel = targetLvl.code,
questions = combined,
currentIndex = 0,
remainingSeconds = 40 * 60
            )
            _weeklyTestMap.value = _weeklyTestMap.value.toMutableMap().apply {
put(courseCode, session)
            }
            _isWeeklyTestScreenOpen.value = true
        }
    }

    fun closeWeeklyTestScreenPause() {
        // Если выйти из теста, он продолжится с того же места, пока не истечёт время (Раздел 9)
        _isWeeklyTestScreenOpen.value = false
    }

    fun submitWeeklyTestQuestion(courseCode: String, userAnswer: String) {
        onUserInteraction()
        val session = _weeklyTestMap.value[courseCode] ?: return
        val q = session.questions.getOrNull(session.currentIndex) ?: return
        val isCorrect = AnswerChecker.check(userAnswer, q.answer).isCorrect
        val updatedAnswers = session.answers.toMutableMap().apply { put(q.id, userAnswer) }
        val updatedMistakes = if (isCorrect) session.mistakes else {
            session.mistakes + MistakeRecord(q.question, userAnswer, q.answer, q.rule)
        }

        if (session.currentIndex + 1 < session.questions.size) {
            _weeklyTestMap.value = _weeklyTestMap.value.toMutableMap().apply {
put(
    courseCode,
    session.copy(
        currentIndex = session.currentIndex + 1,
        answers = updatedAnswers,
        mistakes = updatedMistakes
    )
)
            }
        } else {
            _weeklyTestMap.value = _weeklyTestMap.value.toMutableMap().apply {
put(courseCode, session.copy(answers = updatedAnswers, mistakes = updatedMistakes))
            }
            finishWeeklyTest(courseCode)
        }
    }

    private fun finishWeeklyTest(courseCode: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val session = _weeklyTestMap.value[courseCode] ?: return@launch
            _isWeeklyTestScreenOpen.value = false
            _weeklyTestMap.value = _weeklyTestMap.value.toMutableMap().apply { remove(courseCode) }

            val today = LocalDate.now().toEpochDay()
            // Записываем использованные вопросы на 4 недели
            dao.insertUsedQuestions(
session.questions.map { UsedTestQuestionEntity(courseCode, it.id, today) }
            )

            // Считаем общий процент (>= 75%) и процент по каждому разделу (>= 60%)
            val totalQs = session.questions.size
            val totalCorrect = session.questions.count { q ->
val ans = session.answers[q.id] ?: ""
AnswerChecker.check(ans, q.answer).isCorrect
            }
            val overallPercent = if (totalQs == 0) 0 else ((totalCorrect.toFloat() / totalQs) * 100).roundToInt()

            val sections = session.questions.groupBy { it.section }
            val allSectionsAbove60 = sections.all { (_, qs) ->
val secCorrect = qs.count { q ->
    AnswerChecker.check(session.answers[q.id] ?: "", q.answer).isCorrect
}
val secPct = ((secCorrect.toFloat() / qs.size) * 100).roundToInt()
secPct >= 60
            }

            val passed = overallPercent >= 75 && allSectionsAbove60
            val states = dao.getCourseStatesOnce()
            val st = states.find { it.courseCode == courseCode } ?: CourseStateEntity(courseCode = courseCode)

            val newLevel = if (passed) session.targetLevel else st.currentLevel
            dao.saveCourseState(
st.copy(
    currentLevel = newLevel,
    lastTestEpochDay = today,
    nextTestAvailableEpochDay = today + 7,
    lastWeeklyTestPassed = passed
)
            )

            if (passed && session.targetLevel != "A0") {
dao.insertUnlockedMedal(
    UnlockedMedalEntity("MEDAL_LVL_${courseCode}_${session.targetLevel}", today)
)
            }

            applyTestMistakesConsequences(courseCode, session.targetLevel, session.mistakes)
            recalculateStreakAndMedals(weeklyTestPassedToday = passed)

            _errorReviewState.value = ErrorReviewState(
title = if (passed) "Тест недели пройден! Уровень ${session.targetLevel}" else "Тест недели не пройден ($overallPercent%)",
subtitle = if (passed) "Текущий уровень курса повышен до ${session.targetLevel}." else "Нужно ≥ 75% всего и ≥ 60% в каждом разделе. Повтор через 7 дней.",
nextStepHint = if (passed) "Следующий тест недели через 7 дней будет на уровень выше." else "Неверные слова отправлены в Anki на завтра, а темы помечены «Повторить».",
passed = passed,
scorePercent = overallPercent,
mistakes = session.mistakes
            )
        }
    }

    /**
     * Разбор ошибок после теста (Раздел 10):
     * - Неверные слова попадают в Anki и возвращаются через 1 день.
     * - Юниты с ошибками помечаются «повторить».
     */
    private suspend fun applyTestMistakesConsequences(
        courseCode: String,
        levelCode: String,
        mistakes: List<MistakeRecord>
    ) {
        if (mistakes.isEmpty()) return
        val today = LocalDate.now().toEpochDay()
        val courseWords = dao.getAllWordsOnce().filter { it.courseCode == courseCode && it.level == levelCode }
        for (w in courseWords.take(mistakes.size)) {
            dao.insertWord(
w.copy(
    step = 1,
    nextReviewEpochDay = today + 1,
    introducedEpochDay = if (w.introducedEpochDay == 0L) today else w.introducedEpochDay,
    hadMistake = true
)
            )
        }
        val courseUnits = _parsedCourses.value[courseCode]?.grammarUnits?.filter { it.level == levelCode }.orEmpty()
        for (u in courseUnits) {
            val prev = dao.getGrammarProgressOnce().find { it.courseCode == courseCode && it.unitId == u.id }
            dao.saveGrammarProgress(
GrammarProgressEntity(
    courseCode = courseCode,
    unitId = u.id,
    isCompleted = prev?.isCompleted ?: false,
    needsRepeat = true
)
            )
        }
    }

    fun dismissErrorReview() {
        _errorReviewState.value = null
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // СТРИК И МЕДАЛИ (РАЗДЕЛ 13)
    // ========================================================================

    private suspend fun recalculateStreakAndMedals(weeklyTestPassedToday: Boolean = false) {
        val today = LocalDate.now().toEpochDay()
        val sessions = dao.getSessionsOnce()
        val meta = dao.getMetaOnce() ?: AppMetaEntity()

        val secondsTodayAllCourses = sessions
            .filter { it.epochDay == today && it.courseCode != "ALL_ONLY" }
            .sumOf { it.durationSeconds }

        // День засчитан, если набрано >= 5 минут (300 сек) во всех курсах вместе или пройден тест недели
        val todayQualified = secondsTodayAllCourses >= 300 || weeklyTestPassedToday

        var currentStreak = meta.currentStreakDays
        var longestStreak = meta.longestStreakDays
        var lastQualDay = meta.lastQualifiedStreakEpochDay

        if (lastQualDay >= 0 && today - lastQualDay > 1L) {
            // Пропуск дня обнуляет текущий стрик. Медали остаются.
            currentStreak = 0
        }

        if (todayQualified && lastQualDay != today) {
            currentStreak = if (lastQualDay == today - 1L) currentStreak + 1 else 1
            longestStreak = max(longestStreak, currentStreak)
            lastQualDay = today
        }

        dao.saveMeta(
            meta.copy(
currentStreakDays = currentStreak,
longestStreakDays = longestStreak,
lastQualifiedStreakEpochDay = lastQualDay
            )
        )

        // Открываем общие медали стрика: 7, 14, 21, 28, затем 60, 90 ... 360
        val streakTargets = listOf(7, 14, 21, 28) + (60..360 step 30).toList()
        for (days in streakTargets) {
            if (longestStreak >= days) {
dao.insertUnlockedMedal(UnlockedMedalEntity("MEDAL_STREAK_$days", today))
            }
        }

        // Открываем медали часов отдельно для каждого курса: 1, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000 ч
        val hourTargets = listOf(1, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000)
        for (course in CourseType.entries) {
            val courseSeconds = sessions.filter { it.courseCode == course.code }.sumOf { it.durationSeconds }
            val courseHours = courseSeconds / 3600.0
            for (h in hourTargets) {
if (courseHours >= h) {
    dao.insertUnlockedMedal(UnlockedMedalEntity("MEDAL_HOURS_${course.code}_$h", today))
}
            }
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // НАСТРОЙКИ И ЭКСПОРТ / ИМПОРТ (РАЗДЕЛЫ 12, 16, 17)
    // ========================================================================

    fun updateCourseSettings(
        courseCode: String,
        enabled: Boolean,
        dailyNewLimit: Int,
        explainLang: String
    ) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val st = dao.getCourseStatesOnce().find { it.courseCode == courseCode } ?: return@launch
            dao.saveCourseState(
st.copy(
    enabled = enabled,
    dailyNewLimit = dailyNewLimit.coerceIn(0, 30),
    explainLang = explainLang
)
            )
        }
    }

    fun updateGlobalSettings(
        englishAccent: String,
        remindersEnabled: Boolean,
        reminderHour: Int
    ) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val meta = dao.getMetaOnce() ?: AppMetaEntity()
            dao.saveMeta(
meta.copy(
    englishAccent = englishAccent,
    remindersEnabled = remindersEnabled,
    reminderHour = reminderHour.coerceIn(0, 23)
)
            )
            scheduleOrCancelReminderWork(remindersEnabled)
        }
    }

    fun unlockWeeklyTestNowForTesting(courseCode: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val today = LocalDate.now().toEpochDay()
            val st = dao.getCourseStatesOnce().find { it.courseCode == courseCode } ?: return@launch
            dao.saveCourseState(st.copy(placementCompleted = true, nextTestAvailableEpochDay = today))
        }
    }

    private fun scheduleOrCancelReminderWork(enabled: Boolean) {
        val wm = WorkManager.getInstance(getApplication())
        if (!enabled) {
            wm.cancelUniqueWork("lang_v2_daily_reminder")
        } else {
            val req = PeriodicWorkRequestBuilder<DailyReminderWorker>(24, TimeUnit.HOURS).build()
            wm.enqueueUniquePeriodicWork(
"lang_v2_daily_reminder",
ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.UPDATE,
req
            )
        }
    }

    suspend fun buildBackupJson(): String = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val root = JSONObject()
        val meta = dao.getMetaOnce() ?: AppMetaEntity()
        root.put("meta", JSONObject().apply {
            put("activeCourseCode", meta.activeCourseCode)
            put("currentStreakDays", meta.currentStreakDays)
            put("longestStreakDays", meta.longestStreakDays)
            put("lastQualifiedStreakEpochDay", meta.lastQualifiedStreakEpochDay)
            put("englishAccent", meta.englishAccent)
            put("reminderHour", meta.reminderHour)
            put("remindersEnabled", meta.remindersEnabled)
        })

        val statesArr = JSONArray()
        for (st in dao.getCourseStatesOnce()) {
            statesArr.put(JSONObject().apply {
put("courseCode", st.courseCode)
put("enabled", st.enabled)
put("currentLevel", st.currentLevel)
put("placementCompleted", st.placementCompleted)
put("lastTestEpochDay", st.lastTestEpochDay)
put("nextTestAvailableEpochDay", st.nextTestAvailableEpochDay)
put("lastWeeklyTestPassed", st.lastWeeklyTestPassed)
put("dailyNewLimit", st.dailyNewLimit)
put("explainLang", st.explainLang)
            })
        }
        root.put("courseStates", statesArr)

        val wordsArr = JSONArray()
        for (w in dao.getAllWordsOnce()) {
            wordsArr.put(JSONObject().apply {
put("id", w.id)
put("courseCode", w.courseCode)
put("level", w.level)
put("word", w.word)
put("pos", w.pos)
put("ipa", w.ipa)
put("usWord", w.usWord)
put("translationsRu", w.translationsRu)
put("translationsEn", w.translationsEn)
put("example", w.example)
put("exampleTr", w.exampleTr)
put("equivalentsJson", w.equivalentsJson)
put("isUserAdded", w.isUserAdded)
put("step", w.step)
put("nextReviewEpochDay", w.nextReviewEpochDay)
put("lastReviewedEpochDay", w.lastReviewedEpochDay)
put("introducedEpochDay", w.introducedEpochDay)
put("hadMistake", w.hadMistake)
            })
        }
        root.put("words", wordsArr)

        val gramArr = JSONArray()
        for (g in dao.getGrammarProgressOnce()) {
            gramArr.put(JSONObject().apply {
put("courseCode", g.courseCode)
put("unitId", g.unitId)
put("isCompleted", g.isCompleted)
put("needsRepeat", g.needsRepeat)
            })
        }
        root.put("grammarProgress", gramArr)

        val sessArr = JSONArray()
        for (s in dao.getSessionsOnce()) {
            sessArr.put(JSONObject().apply {
put("courseCode", s.courseCode)
put("startTimeMillis", s.startTimeMillis)
put("endTimeMillis", s.endTimeMillis)
put("durationSeconds", s.durationSeconds)
put("epochDay", s.epochDay)
            })
        }
        root.put("sessions", sessArr)

        val medArr = JSONArray()
        for (m in dao.getUnlockedMedalsOnce()) {
            medArr.put(JSONObject().apply {
put("medalId", m.medalId)
put("unlockedEpochDay", m.unlockedEpochDay)
            })
        }
        root.put("medals", medArr)
        root.toString(2)
    }

    fun restoreBackupJson(jsonStr: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
val root = JSONObject(jsonStr)
val metaObj = root.optJSONObject("meta")
if (metaObj != null) {
    // Папку с данными после импорта нужно выбрать заново (Раздел 17)
    dao.saveMeta(
        AppMetaEntity(
            id = 1,
            activeCourseCode = metaObj.optString("activeCourseCode", "en"),
            currentStreakDays = metaObj.optInt("currentStreakDays", 0),
            longestStreakDays = metaObj.optInt("longestStreakDays", 0),
            lastQualifiedStreakEpochDay = metaObj.optLong("lastQualifiedStreakEpochDay", -1L),
            englishAccent = metaObj.optString("englishAccent", "UK"),
            reminderHour = metaObj.optInt("reminderHour", 19),
            remindersEnabled = metaObj.optBoolean("remindersEnabled", false),
            dataFolderUri = "",
            useInternalStarterFolder = false
        )
    )
}

val stArr = root.optJSONArray("courseStates")
if (stArr != null) {
    val list = mutableListOf<CourseStateEntity>()
    for (i in 0 until stArr.length()) {
        val o = stArr.getJSONObject(i)
        list.add(
            CourseStateEntity(
                courseCode = o.getString("courseCode"),
                enabled = o.optBoolean("enabled", true),
                currentLevel = o.optString("currentLevel", "A0"),
                placementCompleted = o.optBoolean("placementCompleted", false),
                lastTestEpochDay = o.optLong("lastTestEpochDay", 0L),
                nextTestAvailableEpochDay = o.optLong("nextTestAvailableEpochDay", 0L),
                lastWeeklyTestPassed = o.optBoolean("lastWeeklyTestPassed", false),
                dailyNewLimit = o.optInt("dailyNewLimit", 10),
                explainLang = o.optString("explainLang", "ru")
            )
        )
    }
    dao.clearCourseStates()
    dao.saveCourseStates(list)
}

val wArr = root.optJSONArray("words")
if (wArr != null) {
    val list = mutableListOf<WordEntity>()
    for (i in 0 until wArr.length()) {
        val o = wArr.getJSONObject(i)
        list.add(
            WordEntity(
                id = o.getString("id"),
                courseCode = o.getString("courseCode"),
                level = o.getString("level"),
                word = o.getString("word"),
                pos = o.optString("pos", ""),
                ipa = o.optString("ipa", ""),
                usWord = o.optString("usWord", ""),
                translationsRu = o.optString("translationsRu", ""),
                translationsEn = o.optString("translationsEn", ""),
                example = o.optString("example", ""),
                exampleTr = o.optString("exampleTr", ""),
                equivalentsJson = o.optString("equivalentsJson", ""),
                isUserAdded = o.optBoolean("isUserAdded", false),
                step = o.optInt("step", 0),
                nextReviewEpochDay = o.optLong("nextReviewEpochDay", 0L),
                lastReviewedEpochDay = o.optLong("lastReviewedEpochDay", 0L),
                introducedEpochDay = o.optLong("introducedEpochDay", 0L),
                hadMistake = o.optBoolean("hadMistake", false)
            )
        )
    }
    dao.clearWords()
    dao.insertWords(list)
}

val gArr = root.optJSONArray("grammarProgress")
if (gArr != null) {
    val list = mutableListOf<GrammarProgressEntity>()
    for (i in 0 until gArr.length()) {
        val o = gArr.getJSONObject(i)
        list.add(
            GrammarProgressEntity(
                courseCode = o.getString("courseCode"),
                unitId = o.getString("unitId"),
                isCompleted = o.optBoolean("isCompleted", false),
                needsRepeat = o.optBoolean("needsRepeat", false)
            )
        )
    }
    dao.clearGrammarProgress()
    dao.saveGrammarProgressList(list)
}

val sArr = root.optJSONArray("sessions")
if (sArr != null) {
    val list = mutableListOf<StudySessionEntity>()
    for (i in 0 until sArr.length()) {
        val o = sArr.getJSONObject(i)
        list.add(
            StudySessionEntity(
                courseCode = o.getString("courseCode"),
                startTimeMillis = o.getLong("startTimeMillis"),
                endTimeMillis = o.getLong("endTimeMillis"),
                durationSeconds = o.getInt("durationSeconds"),
                epochDay = o.getLong("epochDay")
            )
        )
    }
    dao.clearSessions()
    dao.insertSessions(list)
}

val mArr = root.optJSONArray("medals")
if (mArr != null) {
    val list = mutableListOf<UnlockedMedalEntity>()
    for (i in 0 until mArr.length()) {
        val o = mArr.getJSONObject(i)
        list.add(
            UnlockedMedalEntity(
                medalId = o.getString("medalId"),
                unlockedEpochDay = o.getLong("unlockedEpochDay")
            )
        )
    }
    dao.clearMedals()
    dao.insertUnlockedMedals(list)
}
            } catch (_: Exception) {
            }
        }
    }
}

object V2Colors {

    val Surface = Color(0xFFFFFFFF)
    val SurfaceSubtle = Color(0xFFF2EFE9)
    val Border = Color(0xFFE5E0D8)
    val Primary = Color(0xFF2E6B59)
    val PrimaryLight = Color(0xFFE6F0EC)
    val AccentBlue = Color(0xFF3B5B7E)
    val AccentBlueLight = Color(0xFFE9EFF5)
    val Gold = Color(0xFFB87D2B)
    val GoldLight = Color(0xFFFDF5E6)
    val ErrorCoral = Color(0xFFB84A39)
    val ErrorLight = Color(0xFFFAECE9)
    val TextPrimary = Color(0xFF22262A)
    val TextSecondary = Color(0xFF5E656B)
    val TextMuted = Color(0xFF8C939A)
}

    primary = V2Colors.Primary,
    onPrimary = Color.White,
    primaryContainer = V2Colors.PrimaryLight,
    onPrimaryContainer = V2Colors.Primary,
    secondary = V2Colors.AccentBlue,
    onSecondary = Color.White,
    background = V2Colors.Background,
    onBackground = V2Colors.TextPrimary,
    surface = V2Colors.Surface,
    onSurface = V2Colors.TextPrimary,

)

// ============================================================================
// 10. ГЛАВНАЯ ACTIVITY И КОРНЕВОЙ COMPOSE-КОНТЕЙНЕР (РАЗДЕЛ 3)
// ============================================================================

enum class V2BottomTab(val id: String, val title: String, val icon: androidx.compose.ui.graphics.vector.ImageVector) {
    PROGRESS("PROGRESS", "Прогресс", Icons.Outlined.Analytics),
    ANKI("ANKI", "Anki", Icons.Outlined.Style),
    DICTIONARY("DICTIONARY", "Словарь", Icons.Outlined.MenuBook),
    GRAMMAR("GRAMMAR", "Грамматика", Icons.Outlined.School),
    PROFILE("PROFILE", "Профиль", Icons.Outlined.Person)
}

class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContent {
            MaterialTheme(colorScheme = V2LightScheme) {
LanguageAppV2Root()
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun LanguageAppV2Root(vm: V2ViewModel = viewModel()) {
    val meta by vm.metaFlow.collectAsState()
    val allWords by vm.wordsFlow.collectAsState()
    val grammarProgress by vm.grammarProgressFlow.collectAsState()
    val courseStates by vm.courseStatesFlow.collectAsState()
    val sessions by vm.sessionsFlow.collectAsState()
    val unlockedMedals by vm.unlockedMedalsFlow.collectAsState()
    val parsedCourses by vm.parsedCourses.collectAsState()
    val weeklyTestMap by vm.weeklyTestMap.collectAsState()
    val isWeeklyTestOpen by vm.isWeeklyTestScreenOpen.collectAsState()
    val placementSession by vm.placementSession.collectAsState()
    val errorReview by vm.errorReviewState.collectAsState()

    var selectedTab by remember { mutableStateOf(V2BottomTab.PROGRESS) }

    // Отслеживание сворачивания приложения и блокировки экрана (пауза автоучёта времени)
    val lifecycleOwner = LocalLifecycleOwner.current
    DisposableEffect(lifecycleOwner) {
        val observer = LifecycleEventObserver { _, event ->
            when (event) {
Lifecycle.Event.ON_RESUME -> vm.onAppForegroundChanged(true)
Lifecycle.Event.ON_PAUSE, Lifecycle.Event.ON_STOP -> vm.onAppForegroundChanged(false)
else -> {}
            }
        }
        lifecycleOwner.lifecycle.addObserver(observer)
        onDispose { lifecycleOwner.lifecycle.removeObserver(observer) }
    }

    // Инициализация TextToSpeech и проверка доступности голосов для языков (Раздел 15)
    val context = LocalContext.current
    var ttsEngine by remember { mutableStateOf<TextToSpeech?>(null) }
    var ttsReady by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    DisposableEffect(context) {
        var instance: TextToSpeech? = null
        instance = TextToSpeech(context) { status ->
            if (status == TextToSpeech.SUCCESS) {
ttsReady = true
            }
        }
        ttsEngine = instance
        onDispose {
            instance?.stop()
            instance?.shutdown()
        }
    }

    fun isVoiceAvailableForCourse(courseCode: String): Pair<Boolean, Boolean> {
        val tts = ttsEngine ?: return (false to false)
        if (!ttsReady) return (false to false)
        return when (courseCode) {
            "en" -> {
val loc = if (meta.englishAccent == "US") Locale.US else Locale.UK
val res = tts.isLanguageAvailable(loc)
(res >= TextToSpeech.LANG_AVAILABLE) to false
            }
            "uk" -> {
val res = tts.isLanguageAvailable(Locale("uk", "UA"))
(res >= TextToSpeech.LANG_AVAILABLE) to false
            }
            "pl" -> {
val res = tts.isLanguageAvailable(Locale("pl", "PL"))
(res >= TextToSpeech.LANG_AVAILABLE) to false
            }
            "ru" -> {
val res = tts.isLanguageAvailable(Locale("ru", "RU"))
(res >= TextToSpeech.LANG_AVAILABLE) to false
            }
            "isv" -> {
val slavicLocales = listOf(
    Locale("ru", "RU"), Locale("uk", "UA"), Locale("pl", "PL"),
    Locale("cs", "CZ"), Locale("sk", "SK"), Locale("hr", "HR"), Locale("sr", "RS")
)
val found = slavicLocales.any { tts.isLanguageAvailable(it) >= TextToSpeech.LANG_AVAILABLE }
found to true // true = с пометкой «приближённо»
            }
            else -> false to false
        }
    }

    fun speakCourseText(courseCode: String, text: String) {
        vm.onUserInteraction()
        val tts = ttsEngine ?: return
        if (!ttsReady) return
        val locale = when (courseCode) {
            "en" -> if (meta.englishAccent == "US") Locale.US else Locale.UK
            "uk" -> Locale("uk", "UA")
            "pl" -> Locale("pl", "PL")
            "ru" -> Locale("ru", "RU")
            "isv" -> {
val candidates = listOf(Locale("ru", "RU"), Locale("uk", "UA"), Locale("pl", "PL"), Locale("cs", "CZ"))
candidates.firstOrNull { tts.isLanguageAvailable(it) >= TextToSpeech.LANG_AVAILABLE } ?: Locale("ru", "RU")
            }
            else -> Locale.US
        }
        if (tts.isLanguageAvailable(locale) >= TextToSpeech.LANG_AVAILABLE) {
            tts.language = locale
            tts.speak(text, TextToSpeech.QUEUE_FLUSH, null, "v2_tts")
        }
    }

    // Системный выбор папки с данными (SAF)
    val folderPickerLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        contract = ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocumentTree()
    ) { uri ->
        if (uri != null) {
            vm.setSafDataFolder(uri, populateStarterFiles = true)
        }
