    }

    val activeCourse = CourseType.fromCode(meta.activeCourseCode)
    val activeCourseState = courseStates.find { it.courseCode == activeCourse.code }
        ?: CourseStateEntity(courseCode = activeCourse.code, explainLang = activeCourse.defaultExplainLang)
    val activeCourseData = parsedCourses[activeCourse.code]
        ?: ParsedCourseData(emptyList(), emptyList(), emptyList(), emptyList(), emptyList(), emptyList())
    val hasDataFolderConfigured = meta.dataFolderUri.isNotBlank() || meta.useInternalStarterFolder

    // Корневой перехватчик касаний для автоучёта времени (Раздел 13)
    Scaffold(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .pointerInput(Unit) {
awaitPointerEventScope {
    while (true) {
        awaitPointerEvent()
        vm.onUserInteraction()
    }
}
            },
        containerColor = V2Colors.Background,
        topBar = {
            CourseSwitcherTopBar(
activeCourse = activeCourse,
enabledCourses = courseStates.filter { it.enabled }.map { CourseType.fromCode(it.courseCode) }
    .ifEmpty { CourseType.entries },
streakDays = meta.currentStreakDays,
onSelectCourse = { vm.switchCourse(it.code) }
            )
        },
        bottomBar = {
            NavigationBar(
containerColor = V2Colors.Surface,
tonalElevation = 0.dp
            ) {
V2BottomTab.entries.forEach { tab ->
    NavigationBarItem(
        selected = selectedTab == tab,
        onClick = {
            selectedTab = tab
            vm.onTabSelected(tab.id)
        },
        icon = { Icon(tab.icon, contentDescription = tab.title) },
        label = {
            Text(
                text = tab.title,
                fontSize = 11.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
                maxLines = 1,
                softWrap = false
            )
        },
        colors = NavigationBarItemDefaults.colors(
            selectedIconColor = V2Colors.Primary,
            selectedTextColor = V2Colors.Primary,
            indicatorColor = V2Colors.PrimaryLight,
            unselectedIconColor = V2Colors.TextSecondary,
            unselectedTextColor = V2Colors.TextSecondary
        )
    )
}
            }
        }
    ) { innerPadding ->
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
.fillMaxSize()
.padding(innerPadding)
        ) {
            // Приоритетные полноэкранные режимы: Разбор ошибок, Стартовый тест, Тест недели
            if (errorReview != null) {
ErrorReviewScreen(
    state = errorReview!!,
    onDone = { vm.dismissErrorReview() }
)
            } else if (placementSession != null) {
PlacementTestScreen(
    session = placementSession!!,
    onSubmitAnswer = { vm.answerPlacementQuestion(it) },
    onCancel = { vm.dismissErrorReview() }
)
            } else if (isWeeklyTestOpen && weeklyTestMap[activeCourse.code] != null) {
WeeklyTestScreen(
    session = weeklyTestMap[activeCourse.code]!!,
    onSubmitAnswer = { vm.submitWeeklyTestQuestion(activeCourse.code, it) },
    onPauseAndExit = { vm.closeWeeklyTestScreenPause() }
)
            } else if (!hasDataFolderConfigured && selectedTab != V2BottomTab.PROFILE) {
// Пока папка не выбрана, курсы показывают пустой экран с подсказкой выбрать её (Раздел 14)
EmptyDataFolderPrompt(
    onPickSafFolder = { folderPickerLauncher.launch(null) },
    onUseStarterFiles = { vm.activateInternalStarterFolder() }
)
            } else {
when (selectedTab) {
    V2BottomTab.PROGRESS -> ProgressTabScreen(
        course = activeCourse,
        courseState = activeCourseState,
        courseWords = allWords.filter { it.courseCode == activeCourse.code },
        grammarUnits = activeCourseData.grammarUnits,
        grammarProgress = grammarProgress.filter { it.courseCode == activeCourse.code },
        streakDays = meta.currentStreakDays,
        hasSavedWeeklyTest = weeklyTestMap.containsKey(activeCourse.code),
        onStartPlacementTest = { vm.startPlacementTest(activeCourse.code) },
        onOpenWeeklyTest = { vm.openOrResumeWeeklyTest(activeCourse.code) }
    )
    V2BottomTab.ANKI -> AnkiTabScreen(
        course = activeCourse,
        courseState = activeCourseState,
        allWords = allWords,
        meta = meta,
        getQueue = { lvlFilter ->
            vm.getAnkiQueueForCourse(activeCourse.code, lvlFilter, allWords, activeCourseState)
        },
        voiceStatus = isVoiceAvailableForCourse(activeCourse.code),
        onSpeak = { speakCourseText(activeCourse.code, it) },
        onSubmitResult = { word, isCorrect -> vm.submitAnkiAnswer(word, isCorrect) }
    )
    V2BottomTab.DICTIONARY -> DictionaryTabScreen(
        course = activeCourse,
        courseState = activeCourseState,
        courseWords = allWords.filter { it.courseCode == activeCourse.code },
        useUsEnglish = meta.englishAccent == "US",
        voiceStatus = isVoiceAvailableForCourse(activeCourse.code),
        onSpeak = { speakCourseText(activeCourse.code, it) },
        onRefreshFiles = { vm.reloadDataFiles() },
        onAddCustomWord = { lvl, w, tr, ex ->
            vm.addCustomWord(activeCourse.code, lvl, w, tr, ex)
        }
    )
    V2BottomTab.GRAMMAR -> GrammarAndTextsTabScreen(
        course = activeCourse,
        courseState = activeCourseState,
        grammarUnits = activeCourseData.grammarUnits,
        grammarProgress = grammarProgress.filter { it.courseCode == activeCourse.code },
        texts = activeCourseData.texts,
        glossary = activeCourseData.glossary,
        courseWords = allWords.filter { it.courseCode == activeCourse.code },
        onSubmitUnitQuiz = { unit, correct, mistakes ->
            vm.submitGrammarQuizResult(activeCourse.code, unit, correct, mistakes)
        },
        onAddWordToAnki = { w, tr, lvl ->
            vm.sendTextWordToAnki(activeCourse.code, w, tr, lvl)
        }
    )
    V2BottomTab.PROFILE -> ProfileTabScreen(
        meta = meta,
        courseStates = courseStates,
        allWords = allWords,
        grammarProgress = grammarProgress,
        parsedCourses = parsedCourses,
        sessions = sessions,
        unlockedMedals = unlockedMedals,
        onPickSafFolder = { folderPickerLauncher.launch(null) },
        onActivateInternalStarter = { vm.activateInternalStarterFolder() },
        onUpdateCourseSettings = vm::updateCourseSettings,
        onUpdateGlobalSettings = vm::updateGlobalSettings,
        onUnlockWeeklyTestNow = vm::unlockWeeklyTestNowForTesting,
        onBuildBackupJson = { vm.buildBackupJson() },
        onRestoreBackupJson = { vm.restoreBackupJson(it) }
    )
}
            }
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 11. ВЕРХНИЙ ПЕРЕКЛЮЧАТЕЛЬ КУРСОВ И ЭКРАН ПУСТОЙ ПАПКИ
// ============================================================================

@Composable
fun CourseSwitcherTopBar(
    activeCourse: CourseType,
    enabledCourses: List<CourseType>,
    streakDays: Int,
    onSelectCourse: (CourseType) -> Unit
) {
    Surface(
        color = V2Colors.Surface,
        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border)
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 8.dp)) {
            Row(
modifier = Modifier
    .fillMaxWidth()
    .padding(horizontal = 14.dp),
verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
            ) {
// Горизонтальный переключатель активного курса (English, Українська, Polski, Русский, Межславянский)
LazyRow(
    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
) {
    items(enabledCourses) { course ->
        val selected = course == activeCourse
        Surface(
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            color = if (selected) V2Colors.Primary else V2Colors.SurfaceSubtle,
            modifier = Modifier.clickable { onSelectCourse(course) }
        ) {
            Text(
                text = course.title,
                fontSize = 12.sp,
                fontWeight = if (selected) FontWeight.SemiBold else FontWeight.Normal,
                color = if (selected) Color.White else V2Colors.TextPrimary,
                maxLines = 1,
                softWrap = false,
                modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
            )
        }
    }
}

Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))

// Общий стрик (исправлено сжатие текста из v1: в одну компактную строку)
Surface(
    shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
    color = V2Colors.GoldLight,
    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Gold.copy(alpha = 0.35f))
) {
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 5.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
    ) {
        Icon(
            imageVector = Icons.Default.LocalFireDepartment,
            contentDescription = null,
            tint = V2Colors.Gold,
            modifier = Modifier.size(15.dp)
        )
        Text(
            text = "$streakDays дн.",
            fontSize = 12.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
            color = V2Colors.Gold,
            maxLines = 1,
            softWrap = false
        )
    }
}
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun EmptyDataFolderPrompt(
    onPickSafFolder: () -> Unit,
    onUseStarterFiles: () -> Unit
) {
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .padding(24.dp),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        Surface(
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            color = V2Colors.Surface,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border)
        ) {
            Column(
modifier = Modifier.padding(24.dp),
horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
            ) {
Icon(
    imageVector = Icons.Outlined.FolderOpen,
    contentDescription = null,
    tint = V2Colors.Primary,
    modifier = Modifier.size(44.dp)
)
Text(
    text = "Выберите папку с данными",
    fontSize = 18.sp,
    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
    color = V2Colors.TextPrimary,
    textAlign = TextAlign.Center
)
Text(
    text = "Весь контент курсов (слова, правила, тесты, тексты и картинки) хранится в файлах данных data/en, data/uk, data/pl, data/ru, data/isv.",
    fontSize = 13.sp,
    color = V2Colors.TextSecondary,
    textAlign = TextAlign.Center
)
Button(
    onClick = onPickSafFolder,
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = V2Colors.Primary)
) {
    Text("Выбрать папку на телефоне")
}
OutlinedButton(
    onClick = onUseStarterFiles,
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
) {
    Text("Создать файлы-заготовки автоматически")
}
            }
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 12. ВКЛАДКА 1: ПРОГРЕСС (РАЗДЕЛ 4 — МИНИМУМ ТЕКСТА, A0–C2, СТАРТ И ТЕСТ НЕДЕЛИ)
// ============================================================================

@Composable
fun ProgressTabScreen(
    course: CourseType,
    courseState: CourseStateEntity,
    courseWords: List<WordEntity>,
    grammarUnits: List<GrammarUnitData>,
    grammarProgress: List<GrammarProgressEntity>,
    streakDays: Int,
    hasSavedWeeklyTest: Boolean,
    onStartPlacementTest: () -> Unit,
    onOpenWeeklyTest: () -> Unit
) {
    val today = LocalDate.now().toEpochDay()
    val dueReviews = courseWords.count { it.isInReview && it.nextReviewEpochDay <= today }
    val introducedToday = courseWords.count { it.introducedEpochDay == today }
    val newAvailableToday = if (courseState.overloadLocked || dueReviews > 50 || courseState.dailyNewLimit <= 0) 0
    else min(courseWords.count { it.isNew }, max(0, courseState.dailyNewLimit - introducedToday))

    val weeklyTestAvailable = courseState.placementCompleted && courseState.nextTestAvailableEpochDay <= today
    val daysUntilNextTest = max(0L, courseState.nextTestAvailableEpochDay - today)
    val nextTestDateStr = if (courseState.nextTestAvailableEpochDay > 0L) {
        LocalDate.ofEpochDay(courseState.nextTestAvailableEpochDay).toString()
    } else "после стартового теста"

    LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
        contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        // 1. Блок «Сегодня»
        item {
            Surface(
shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
color = V2Colors.Surface,
border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border)
            ) {
Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {
    Text(
        text = "Сегодня • ${course.title}",
        fontSize = 16.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        color = V2Colors.TextPrimary
    )
    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
    ) {
        StatMiniBox(
            label = "Новые",
            value = "$newAvailableToday",
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
        )
        StatMiniBox(
            label = "Повторы",
            value = "$dueReviews",
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
        )
        StatMiniBox(
            label = "Стрик",
            value = "$streakDays дн.",
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
        )
    }
    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
    Text(
        text = "План дня: закрыть повторы и новые слова курса.",
        fontSize = 12.sp,
        color = V2Colors.TextSecondary
    )
}
            }
        }

        // 2. Карточка «Тест недели» (и Стартовый тест при первом выборе курса)
        item {
            Surface(
shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
color = V2Colors.Surface,
border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border)
            ) {
Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text(
                text = if (!courseState.placementCompleted) "Стартовый тест курса" else "Тест недели",
                fontSize = 16.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                color = V2Colors.TextPrimary
            )
            Text(
                text = when {
                    !courseState.placementCompleted -> "Определит ваш начальный уровень (${course.title})."
                    hasSavedWeeklyTest -> "Тест на паузе — можно продолжить."
                    weeklyTestAvailable -> "Доступен для повышения уровня до ${CefrLevel.fromCode(courseState.currentLevel).nextLevel()?.code ?: "C2"}."
                    else -> "Следующий тест: $nextTestDateStr (через $daysUntilNextTest дн.)."
                },
                fontSize = 12.sp,
                color = V2Colors.TextSecondary
            )
        }
        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(10.dp))
        if (!courseState.placementCompleted) {
            Button(
                onClick = onStartPlacementTest,
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = V2Colors.Primary)
            ) {
                Text("Начать", maxLines = 1, softWrap = false)
            }
        } else if (weeklyTestAvailable || hasSavedWeeklyTest) {
            Button(
                onClick = onOpenWeeklyTest,
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = V2Colors.Primary)
            ) {
                Text(if (hasSavedWeeklyTest) "Продолжить" else "Пройти", maxLines = 1, softWrap = false)
            }
        } else {
            Surface(
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                color = V2Colors.SurfaceSubtle
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = "Уровень ${courseState.currentLevel}",
                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                    color = V2Colors.TextSecondary,
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
            }
        }

        // 3. Прогресс по уровням A0, A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2
        item {
            Text(
text = "Уровни A0–C2",
fontSize = 15.sp,
fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
color = V2Colors.TextPrimary
            )
        }

        items(CefrLevel.entries) { level ->
            val lvlWords = courseWords.filter { it.level == level.code }
            val masteredCount = lvlWords.count { it.isMastered }
            val wordsTotal = lvlWords.size
            val wordsFraction = if (wordsTotal == 0) 0f else masteredCount.toFloat() / wordsTotal

            val lvlUnits = grammarUnits.filter { it.level == level.code }
            val completedUnitIds = grammarProgress.filter { it.isCompleted }.map { it.unitId }.toSet()
            val completedUnits = lvlUnits.count { it.id in completedUnitIds }
            val unitsTotal = lvlUnits.size
            val unitsFraction = if (unitsTotal == 0) 0f else completedUnits.toFloat() / unitsTotal
            val grammarLabel = if (course == CourseType.ISV) "Карточки-правила" else "Грамматика"

            Surface(
shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
color = V2Colors.Surface,
border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border)
            ) {
Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp)) {
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        Surface(
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
            color = if (courseState.currentLevel == level.code) V2Colors.Primary else V2Colors.SurfaceSubtle
        ) {
            Text(
                text = level.code,
                fontSize = 14.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                color = if (courseState.currentLevel == level.code) Color.White else V2Colors.TextPrimary,
                modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
            )
        }
        Text(
            text = "Слова: $masteredCount/$wordsTotal • $grammarLabel: $completedUnits/$unitsTotal",
            fontSize = 12.sp,
            color = V2Colors.TextSecondary
        )
    }
    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text("Закреплено слов: ${(wordsFraction * 100).roundToInt()}%", fontSize = 11.sp, color = V2Colors.TextSecondary)
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
            LinearProgressIndicator(
                progress = { wordsFraction },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(6.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(3.dp)),
                color = V2Colors.Primary,
                trackColor = V2Colors.SurfaceSubtle
            )
        }
        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text("$grammarLabel: ${(unitsFraction * 100).roundToInt()}%", fontSize = 11.sp, color = V2Colors.TextSecondary)
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
            LinearProgressIndicator(
                progress = { unitsFraction },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(6.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(3.dp)),
                color = V2Colors.AccentBlue,
                trackColor = V2Colors.SurfaceSubtle
            )
        }
    }
}
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun StatMiniBox(label: String, value: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    Surface(
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
        color = V2Colors.SurfaceSubtle,
        modifier = modifier
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.padding(vertical = 10.dp, horizontal = 8.dp),
            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
        ) {
            Text(
text = value,
fontSize = 16.sp,
fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
color = V2Colors.TextPrimary,
maxLines = 1,
softWrap = false
            )
            Text(
text = label,
fontSize = 11.sp,
color = V2Colors.TextSecondary,
maxLines = 1,
softWrap = false
            )
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 13. ВКЛАДКА 2: ANKI (РАЗДЕЛ 5 И 6 — ВВОД ОТВЕТА, КАРТИНКИ, 1-3-7-14-30 ДНЕЙ)
// ============================================================================

@Composable
fun AnkiTabScreen(
    course: CourseType,
    courseState: CourseStateEntity,
    allWords: List<WordEntity>,
    meta: AppMetaEntity,
    getQueue: (String?) -> List<WordEntity>,
    voiceStatus: Pair<Boolean, Boolean>,
    onSpeak: (String) -> Unit,
    onSubmitResult: (WordEntity, Boolean) -> Unit
) {
    var selectedLevelFilter by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    val queue = remember(allWords, course.code, selectedLevelFilter, courseState) {
        getQueue(selectedLevelFilter)
    }

    var currentWordId by remember(course.code, selectedLevelFilter) {
        mutableStateOf(queue.firstOrNull()?.id)
    }
    val currentWord = remember(queue, currentWordId) {
        queue.find { it.id == currentWordId } ?: queue.firstOrNull()
    }

    var userInput by remember(currentWord?.id) { mutableStateOf("") }
    var checkResult by remember(currentWord?.id) { mutableStateOf<AnswerCheckResult?>(null) }
    var forgotPressed by remember(currentWord?.id) { mutableStateOf(false) }

    val context = LocalContext.current
    val wordBitmap = remember(currentWord?.id, meta.dataFolderUri, meta.useInternalStarterFolder) {
        currentWord?.let {
            DataFolderParser.loadWordBitmap(context, meta.dataFolderUri, meta.useInternalStarterFolder, it.id)
        }
    }

    val useUsEnglish = meta.englishAccent == "US"
    val (canSpeak, isApproxVoice) = voiceStatus

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .padding(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        // Сверху фильтр по уровням: «Все уровни», A0, A1, …, C2
        LevelFilterRow(
            selectedLevel = selectedLevelFilter,
            onSelectLevel = {
selectedLevelFilter = it
userInput = ""
checkResult = null
forgotPressed = false
            }
        )

        if (currentWord == null) {
            Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
Surface(
    shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
    color = V2Colors.Surface,
    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border)
) {
    Column(
        modifier = Modifier.padding(24.dp),
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
    ) {
        Icon(
            imageVector = Icons.Outlined.CheckCircle,
            contentDescription = null,
            tint = V2Colors.Primary,
            modifier = Modifier.size(36.dp)
        )
        Text(
            text = "На сегодня карточек в очереди нет",
            fontSize = 16.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            color = V2Colors.TextPrimary
        )
        Text(
            text = if (courseState.overloadLocked)
                "Накопилось больше 50 повторов: новые слова приостановлены до разбора очереди (<20)."
            else
                "Все повторы и дневной лимит новых слов пройдены.",
            fontSize = 12.sp,
            color = V2Colors.TextSecondary,
            textAlign = TextAlign.Center
        )
    }
}
            }
            return@Column
        }

        Surface(
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp),
            color = V2Colors.Surface,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border),
            modifier = Modifier
.fillMaxWidth()
.weight(1f)
        ) {
            Column(
modifier = Modifier
    .fillMaxSize()
    .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
    .padding(20.dp),
horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
            ) {
// Верхняя плашка уровня и статуса карточки
Row(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
) {
    Surface(
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
        color = V2Colors.AccentBlueLight
    ) {
        Text(
            text = "${currentWord.level} • ${currentWord.pos}",
            fontSize = 12.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
            color = V2Colors.AccentBlue,
            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
        )
    }
    Text(
        text = currentWord.statusLabel(),
        fontSize = 12.sp,
        color = V2Colors.TextSecondary
    )
}

Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

// Центр: Картинка (только если файл есть; если нет — без пустого места), Слово, Транскрипция, Озвучка
Column(
    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
) {
    if (wordBitmap != null) {
        Image(
            bitmap = wordBitmap.asImageBitmap(),
            contentDescription = null,
            modifier = Modifier
                .size(148.dp)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                .border(1.dp, V2Colors.Border, RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
        )
    }

    Text(
        text = currentWord.displayWord(useUsEnglish),
        fontSize = 30.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        color = V2Colors.TextPrimary,
        textAlign = TextAlign.Center
    )

    if (currentWord.ipa.isNotBlank()) {
        Text(
            text = currentWord.ipa,
            fontSize = 16.sp,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            color = V2Colors.TextSecondary
        )
    }

    if (canSpeak) {
        OutlinedButton(
            onClick = { onSpeak(currentWord.displayWord(useUsEnglish)) },
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp),
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
        ) {
            Icon(
                imageVector = Icons.Default.VolumeUp,
                contentDescription = "Озвучить",
                modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
            )
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
            Text(
                text = if (isApproxVoice) "Озвучка (приближённо)" else "Озвучить",
                fontSize = 12.sp
            )
        }
    }
}

Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))

// Блок ввода перевода и результата
val isAnswered = checkResult != null || forgotPressed
val acceptedRaw = currentWord.acceptedTranslations(courseState.explainLang)

if (!isAnswered) {
    Column(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
    ) {
        OutlinedTextField(
            value = userInput,
            onValueChange = { userInput = it },
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            label = {
                Text(
                    if (courseState.explainLang == "en") "Введите перевод (EN)"
                    else "Введите перевод (RU)"
                )
            },
            singleLine = true,
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
        )

        // Кнопки по ТЗ (Раздел 5): «Не помню» до ввода, «Проверить» после ввода
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
        ) {
            if (userInput.isBlank()) {
                OutlinedButton(
                    onClick = {
                        forgotPressed = true
                        onSubmitResult(currentWord, false)
                    },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(48.dp),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.ErrorCoral)
                ) {
                    Text("Не помню", color = V2Colors.ErrorCoral, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                }
            } else {
                Button(
                    onClick = {
                        val res = AnswerChecker.check(userInput, acceptedRaw)
                        checkResult = res
                        onSubmitResult(currentWord, res.isCorrect)
                    },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(48.dp),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = V2Colors.Primary)
                ) {
                    Text("Проверить", fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                }
            }
        }
    }
} else {
    val isOk = checkResult?.isCorrect == true && !forgotPressed
    Surface(
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
        color = if (isOk) V2Colors.PrimaryLight else V2Colors.ErrorLight,
        border = BorderStroke(
            1.dp,
            if (isOk) V2Colors.Primary.copy(alpha = 0.35f)
            else V2Colors.ErrorCoral.copy(alpha = 0.35f)
        ),
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp),
            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
        ) {
            val headerText = when {
                forgotPressed -> "Не помню • повтор через 1 день"
                isOk && checkResult?.note?.isNotBlank() == true ->
                    "Верно (${checkResult!!.note})"
                isOk -> "Верно!"
                else -> "Неверно • повтор через 1 день"
            }
            Text(
                text = headerText,
                fontSize = 13.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                color = if (isOk) V2Colors.Primary else V2Colors.ErrorCoral
            )
            Text(
                text = acceptedRaw.replace("|", ", "),
                fontSize = 20.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                color = V2Colors.TextPrimary,
                textAlign = TextAlign.Center
            )
            if (currentWord.example.isNotBlank()) {
                Divider(color = V2Colors.Border)
                Text(
                    text = currentWord.example,
                    fontSize = 13.sp,
                    fontStyle = FontStyle.Italic,
                    color = V2Colors.TextPrimary,
                    textAlign = TextAlign.Center
                )
                if (currentWord.exampleTr.isNotBlank()) {
                    Text(
                        text = currentWord.exampleTr,
                        fontSize = 12.sp,
                        color = V2Colors.TextSecondary,
                        textAlign = TextAlign.Center
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

    Button(
        onClick = {
            val nextWord = queue.firstOrNull { it.id != currentWord.id }
            currentWordId = nextWord?.id
            userInput = ""
            checkResult = null
            forgotPressed = false
        },
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(48.dp),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = V2Colors.Primary)
    ) {
        Text("Далее", fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
    }
}
            }
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 14. ВКЛАДКА 3: СЛОВАРЬ (РАЗДЕЛ 7 — ИЗ ФАЙЛА КУРСА, ПОИСК, «+», СООТВЕТСТВИЯ ISV)
// ============================================================================

@Composable
fun DictionaryTabScreen(
    course: CourseType,
    courseState: CourseStateEntity,
    courseWords: List<WordEntity>,
    useUsEnglish: Boolean,
    voiceStatus: Pair<Boolean, Boolean>,
    onSpeak: (String) -> Unit,
    onRefreshFiles: () -> Unit,
    onAddCustomWord: (String, String, String, String) -> Unit
) {
    var searchQuery by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var selectedLevel by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var showAddDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    val filteredWords = remember(courseWords, searchQuery, selectedLevel) {
        courseWords.filter { w ->
            val matchLevel = selectedLevel == null || w.level == selectedLevel
            val q = searchQuery.trim().lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
            val matchQuery = q.isEmpty() ||
w.word.lowercase(Locale.ROOT).contains(q) ||
w.translationsRu.lowercase(Locale.ROOT).contains(q) ||
w.translationsEn.lowercase(Locale.ROOT).contains(q)
            matchLevel && matchQuery
        }
    }

    val (canSpeak, isApproxVoice) = voiceStatus

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .padding(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
    ) {
        // Верхняя строка: норма уровня (из файла), кнопки «Обновить» и «+»
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
Text(
    text = "Словарь • ${course.title}",
    fontSize = 17.sp,
    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
    color = V2Colors.TextPrimary
)
Text(
    text = if (selectedLevel == null) "Всего слов в файле: ${courseWords.size}"
    else "Норма уровня $selectedLevel: ${courseWords.count { it.level == selectedLevel }} слов",
    fontSize = 12.sp,
    color = V2Colors.TextSecondary
)
            }
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
OutlinedButton(
    onClick = onRefreshFiles,
    shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
    contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
) {
    Text("Обновить", fontSize = 12.sp, maxLines = 1, softWrap = false)
}
Button(
    onClick = { showAddDialog = true },
    shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = V2Colors.Primary),
    contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
) {
    Text("+", fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
}
            }
        }

        OutlinedTextField(
            value = searchQuery,
            onValueChange = { searchQuery = it },
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            placeholder = { Text("Поиск по слову или переводу...") },
            singleLine = true,
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
        )

        LevelFilterRow(
            selectedLevel = selectedLevel,
            onSelectLevel = { selectedLevel = it }
        )

        LazyColumn(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
        ) {
            items(filteredWords, key = { it.id }) { word ->
Surface(
    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
    color = V2Colors.Surface,
    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border)
) {
    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp)) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = word.displayWord(useUsEnglish),
                        fontSize = 16.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        color = V2Colors.TextPrimary
                    )
                    if (word.ipa.isNotBlank()) {
                        Text(
                            text = word.ipa,
                            fontSize = 12.sp,
                            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                            color = V2Colors.TextSecondary
                        )
                    }
                    Surface(
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
                        color = V2Colors.SurfaceSubtle
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = word.level,
                            fontSize = 10.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            color = V2Colors.TextSecondary,
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                        )
                    }
                }
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
                Text(
                    text = word.acceptedTranslations(courseState.explainLang).replace("|", ", "),
                    fontSize = 14.sp,
                    color = V2Colors.TextPrimary
                )
            }

            Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
            ) {
                if (canSpeak) {
                    IconButton(onClick = { onSpeak(word.displayWord(useUsEnglish)) }) {
                        Icon(
                            imageVector = Icons.Default.VolumeUp,
                            contentDescription = "Озвучить",
                            tint = V2Colors.Primary
                        )
                    }
                }
                Surface(
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                    color = if (word.isMastered) V2Colors.PrimaryLight else V2Colors.SurfaceSubtle
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = word.statusLabel(),
                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
                        color = if (word.isMastered) V2Colors.Primary else V2Colors.TextSecondary,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        softWrap = false,
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        if (course == CourseType.ISV && isApproxVoice && canSpeak) {
            Text(
                text = "Озвучка: приближённо",
                fontSize = 10.sp,
                color = V2Colors.TextMuted
            )
        }

        // Для межславянского показываются соответствия в 11 славянских языках (Раздел 7)
        if (course == CourseType.ISV && word.equivalentsJson.isNotBlank()) {
            val eqText = remember(word.equivalentsJson) {
                try {
                    val obj = JSONObject(word.equivalentsJson)
                    val langs = listOf("ru", "uk", "pl", "be", "cs", "sk", "sl", "hr", "sr", "bg", "mk")
                    langs.mapNotNull { k ->
                        val v = obj.optString(k, "")
                        if (v.isNotBlank()) "${k.uppercase()}: $v" else null
                    }.joinToString(" • ")
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                    ""
                }
            }
            if (eqText.isNotBlank()) {
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
                Surface(
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                    color = V2Colors.SurfaceSubtle,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = eqText,
                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                        color = V2Colors.TextSecondary,
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(8.dp)
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
            }
        }
    }

    if (showAddDialog) {
        var newWord by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
        var newTranslation by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
        var newExample by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
        var newLevel by remember { mutableStateOf(selectedLevel ?: "A1") }

        // Специальные буквы для украинского (і, ї, є, ґ) и польского (ą, ć, ę, ł, ń, ó, ś, ź, ż) (Раздел 15)
        val specialChars = when (course) {
            CourseType.UK -> listOf("і", "ї", "є", "ґ")
            CourseType.PL -> listOf("ą", "ć", "ę", "ł", "ń", "ó", "ś", "ź", "ż")
            else -> emptyList()
        }

        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { showAddDialog = false },
            containerColor = V2Colors.Surface,
            title = { Text("Добавить своё слово (${course.title})", fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) },
            text = {
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
    LazyRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
        items(CefrLevel.entries) { lvl ->
            FilterChip(
                selected = newLevel == lvl.code,
                onClick = { newLevel = lvl.code },
                label = { Text(lvl.code, fontSize = 11.sp) }
            )
        }
    }
    if (specialChars.isNotEmpty()) {
        LazyRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
            items(specialChars) { ch ->
                AssistChip(
                    onClick = { newWord += ch },
                    label = { Text(ch, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) }
                )
            }
        }
    }
    OutlinedTextField(
        value = newWord,
        onValueChange = { newWord = it },
        label = { Text("Слово курса") },
        singleLine = true
    )
    OutlinedTextField(
        value = newTranslation,
        onValueChange = { newTranslation = it },
        label = { Text("Перевод (варианты через |)") },
        singleLine = true
    )
    OutlinedTextField(
        value = newExample,
        onValueChange = { newExample = it },
        label = { Text("Пример (необязательно)") },
        singleLine = true
    )
}
            },
            confirmButton = {
Button(
    onClick = {
        if (newWord.isNotBlank() && newTranslation.isNotBlank()) {
            onAddCustomWord(newLevel, newWord, newTranslation, newExample)
            showAddDialog = false
        }
    },
    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = V2Colors.Primary)
) {
    Text("Добавить в Anki")
}
            },
            dismissButton = {
TextButton(onClick = { showAddDialog = false }) { Text("Отмена") }
            }
        )
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 15. ВКЛАДКА 4: ГРАММАТИКА И ТЕКСТЫ (РАЗДЕЛЫ 8, 11, 18 — ЮНИТЫ, ГЛОССАРИЙ, ВИКИПЕДИЯ, ТАП ПО СЛОВАМ)
// ============================================================================

@Composable
fun GrammarAndTextsTabScreen(
    course: CourseType,
    courseState: CourseStateEntity,
    grammarUnits: List<GrammarUnitData>,
    grammarProgress: List<GrammarProgressEntity>,
    texts: List<ReadingTextData>,
    glossary: List<GlossaryEntry>,
    courseWords: List<WordEntity>,
    onSubmitUnitQuiz: (GrammarUnitData, Int, List<MistakeRecord>) -> Unit,
    onAddWordToAnki: (String, String, String) -> Unit
) {
    var mode by remember { mutableStateOf("RULES") } // "RULES", "TEXTS", "GLOSSARY"
    var selectedLevel by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var activeUnit by remember { mutableStateOf<GrammarUnitData?>(null) }
    var activeText by remember { mutableStateOf<ReadingTextData?>(null) }
    var selectedGlossaryTerm by remember { mutableStateOf<GlossaryEntry?>(null) }

    val context = LocalContext.current

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .padding(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
    ) {
        // Вверху переключатель «Правила» и «Тексты» + кнопка «Справочник» (Раздел 8, 18)
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
        ) {
            listOf(
"RULES" to "Правила",
"TEXTS" to "Тексты",
"GLOSSARY" to "Справочник"
            ).forEach { (key, title) ->
val selected = mode == key
Surface(
    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
    color = if (selected) V2Colors.Primary else V2Colors.SurfaceSubtle,
    modifier = Modifier
        .weight(1f)
        .clickable {
            mode = key
            activeUnit = null
            activeText = null
        }
) {
    Text(
        text = title,
        fontSize = 13.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
        color = if (selected) Color.White else V2Colors.TextPrimary,
        textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
        maxLines = 1,
        softWrap = false,
        modifier = Modifier.padding(vertical = 10.dp)
    )
}
            }
        }

        if (activeUnit != null) {
            GrammarUnitDetailView(
unit = activeUnit!!,
glossary = glossary,
onTermClick = { selectedGlossaryTerm = it },
onBack = { activeUnit = null },
onSubmitQuiz = { correct, mistakes ->
    val u = activeUnit!!
    activeUnit = null
    onSubmitUnitQuiz(u, correct, mistakes)
}
            )
        } else if (activeText != null) {
            InteractiveReadingTextView(
textData = activeText!!,
courseWords = courseWords,
explainLang = courseState.explainLang,
onBack = { activeText = null },
onAddWordToAnki = { w, tr -> onAddWordToAnki(w, tr, activeText!!.level) }
            )
        } else if (mode == "GLOSSARY") {
            LazyColumn(
modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
            ) {
items(glossary) { item ->
    Surface(
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
        color = V2Colors.Surface,
        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border),
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clickable { selectedGlossaryTerm = item }
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp)) {
            Text(item.term, fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.Primary)
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
            Text(item.explanation, fontSize = 13.sp, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
            if (item.example.isNotBlank()) {
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
                Text("Пример: ${item.example}", fontSize = 12.sp, color = V2Colors.TextSecondary)
            }
        }
    }
}
            }
        } else {
            LevelFilterRow(selectedLevel = selectedLevel, onSelectLevel = { selectedLevel = it })

            if (mode == "RULES") {
val filteredUnits = grammarUnits.filter { selectedLevel == null || it.level == selectedLevel }
val progressMap = grammarProgress.associateBy { it.unitId }

LazyColumn(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
) {
    items(filteredUnits, key = { it.id }) { unit ->
        val prog = progressMap[unit.id]
        Surface(
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
            color = V2Colors.Surface,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border),
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .clickable { activeUnit = unit }
        ) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Text(
                        text = "${unit.level} • Юнит ${unit.number}",
                        fontSize = 11.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        color = V2Colors.AccentBlue
                    )
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = unit.title,
                        fontSize = 15.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                        color = V2Colors.TextPrimary
                    )
                }
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                when {
                    prog?.needsRepeat == true -> {
                        Surface(shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp), color = V2Colors.ErrorLight) {
                            Text(
                                "Повторить",
                                fontSize = 11.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                color = V2Colors.ErrorCoral,
                                modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    prog?.isCompleted == true -> {
                        Surface(shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp), color = V2Colors.PrimaryLight) {
                            Text(
                                "Пройдено",
                                fontSize = 11.sp,
                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                color = V2Colors.Primary,
                                modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
            } else {
// Список текстов курса (Раздел 11)
val filteredTexts = texts.filter { selectedLevel == null || it.level == selectedLevel }
LazyColumn(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
) {
    items(filteredTexts, key = { it.id }) { txt ->
        Surface(
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
            color = V2Colors.Surface,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border),
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .clickable { activeText = txt }
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp)) {
                Text(
                    text = "Уровень ${txt.level}",
                    fontSize = 11.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    color = V2Colors.Primary
                )
                Text(
                    text = txt.title,
                    fontSize = 15.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                    color = V2Colors.TextPrimary
                )
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
                Text(
                    text = txt.text,
                    fontSize = 13.sp,
                    color = V2Colors.TextSecondary,
                    maxLines = 2,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
            }
        }
    }

    // Попап объяснения термина глоссария + кнопка «Открыть в Википедии» (Раздел 8, 18)
    if (selectedGlossaryTerm != null) {
        val term = selectedGlossaryTerm!!
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { selectedGlossaryTerm = null },
            containerColor = V2Colors.Surface,
            title = { Text(term.term, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold) },
            text = {
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
    Text(term.explanation, fontSize = 14.sp, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
    if (term.example.isNotBlank()) {
        Surface(
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
            color = V2Colors.SurfaceSubtle,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
        ) {
            Text(
                text = "Пример: ${term.example}",
                fontSize = 13.sp,
                color = V2Colors.TextSecondary,
                modifier = Modifier.padding(10.dp)
            )
        }
    }
}
            },
            confirmButton = {
OutlinedButton(
    onClick = {
        val wikiUrl = "https://${course.wikiDomain}/wiki/${Uri.encode(term.term)}"
        context.startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(wikiUrl)))
    }
) {
    Text("Открыть в Википедии")
}
            },
            dismissButton = {
TextButton(onClick = { selectedGlossaryTerm = null }) { Text("Закрыть") }
            }
        )
    }
}

@Composable
fun GrammarUnitDetailView(
    unit: GrammarUnitData,
    glossary: List<GlossaryEntry>,
    onTermClick: (GlossaryEntry) -> Unit,
    onBack: () -> Unit,
    onSubmitQuiz: (Int, List<MistakeRecord>) -> Unit
) {
    var quizAnswers by remember(unit.id) { mutableStateOf<Map<Int, String>>(emptyMap()) }

    // Подсветка терминов глоссария в тексте правила
    val annotatedRule = remember(unit.rule, glossary) {
        buildAnnotatedString {
            val text = unit.rule
            append(text)
            for (g in glossary) {
val regex = Regex(Regex.escape(g.term), RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
regex.findAll(text).forEach { match ->
    addStyle(
        style = SpanStyle(
            color = V2Colors.Primary,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
            textDecoration = TextDecoration.Underline
        ),
        start = match.range.first,
        end = match.range.last + 1
    )
    addStringAnnotation(
        tag = "TERM",
        annotation = g.term,
        start = match.range.first,
        end = match.range.last + 1
    )
}
            }
        }
    }

    LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        item {
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
TextButton(onClick = onBack) { Text("← К списку") }
Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
Text("${unit.level} • Юнит ${unit.number}", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.AccentBlue)
            }
            Text(unit.title, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
        }

        // 1. Правило простыми словами (с кликабельными терминами)
        item {
            Surface(
shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
color = V2Colors.Surface,
border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border)
            ) {
Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp)) {
    Text("Правило (нажмите на подчеркнутый термин для справки)", fontSize = 11.sp, color = V2Colors.TextSecondary)
    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
    ClickableText(
        text = annotatedRule,
        style = LocalTextStyle.current.copy(fontSize = 14.sp, lineHeight = 20.sp, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary),
        onClick = { offset ->
            annotatedRule.getStringAnnotations("TERM", offset, offset).firstOrNull()?.let { ann ->
                glossary.find { it.term.equals(ann.item, ignoreCase = true) }?.let(onTermClick)
            }
        }
    )
}
            }
        }

        // 2. Схема
        if (unit.formula.isNotBlank()) {
            item {
Surface(
    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
    color = V2Colors.PrimaryLight,
    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Primary.copy(alpha = 0.3f))
) {
    Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(14.dp)) {
        Text("Схема", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.Primary)
        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
        Text(unit.formula, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
    }
}
            }
        }

        // 3. Три примера
        item {
            Surface(
shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
color = V2Colors.Surface,
border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border)
            ) {
Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
    Text("Примеры", fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.TextSecondary)
    unit.examples.forEach { ex ->
        Column {
            Text(ex.text, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
            Text(ex.tr, fontSize = 12.sp, color = V2Colors.TextSecondary)
        }
    }
}
            }
        }

        // 4. Блок «Частая ошибка»
        if (unit.commonMistake.isNotBlank()) {
            item {
Surface(
    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
    color = V2Colors.ErrorLight,
    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.ErrorCoral.copy(alpha = 0.3f))
) {
    Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(14.dp)) {
        Text("Частая ошибка", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.ErrorCoral)
        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
        Text(unit.commonMistake, fontSize = 13.sp, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
    }
}
            }
        }

        // 5. Мини-тест из 5 вопросов (засчитан при 4 верных ответах)
        item {
            Text("Мини-тест (нужно 4 из 5 верных)", fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
        }

        items(unit.quiz.indices.toList()) { qIdx ->
            val q = unit.quiz[qIdx]
            val selectedOpt = quizAnswers[qIdx]
            Surface(
shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
color = V2Colors.Surface,
border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border)
            ) {
Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
    Text("${qIdx + 1}. ${q.question}", fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
    q.options.forEach { opt ->
        Row(
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .clickable {
                    quizAnswers = quizAnswers.toMutableMap().apply { put(qIdx, opt) }
                }
                .padding(vertical = 4.dp)
        ) {
            RadioButton(
                selected = selectedOpt == opt,
                onClick = {
                    quizAnswers = quizAnswers.toMutableMap().apply { put(qIdx, opt) }
                }
            )
            Text(opt, fontSize = 13.sp, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
        }
    }
}
            }
        }

        item {
            Button(
onClick = {
    var correct = 0
    val mistakes = mutableListOf<MistakeRecord>()
    unit.quiz.forEachIndexed { idx, q ->
        val userAns = quizAnswers[idx] ?: ""
        if (userAns == q.answer) {
            correct++
        } else {
            mistakes.add(MistakeRecord(q.question, userAns.ifBlank { "—" }, q.answer, q.rule))
        }
    }
    onSubmitQuiz(correct, mistakes)
},
enabled = quizAnswers.size == unit.quiz.size,
modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(48.dp),
shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = V2Colors.Primary)
            ) {
Text("Проверить мини-тест")
            }
        }
    }
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalLayoutApi::class)
@Composable
fun InteractiveReadingTextView(
    textData: ReadingTextData,
    courseWords: List<WordEntity>,
    explainLang: String,
    onBack: () -> Unit,
    onAddWordToAnki: (String, String) -> Unit
) {
    var tappedWord by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    val tokens = remember(textData.text) {
        textData.text.split(Regex("\\s+")).filter { it.isNotBlank() }
    }

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            TextButton(onClick = onBack) { Text("← К текстам") }
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
            Text("Уровень ${textData.level}", fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.Primary)
        }

        Text(textData.title, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
        Text("Нажмите на любое слово в тексте, чтобы увидеть перевод и добавить его в Anki.", fontSize = 12.sp, color = V2Colors.TextSecondary)

        Surface(
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
            color = V2Colors.Surface,
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border),
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
        ) {
            FlowRow(
modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp),
horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
            ) {
tokens.forEach { token ->
    Surface(
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
        color = if (tappedWord == token) V2Colors.PrimaryLight else Color.Transparent,
        modifier = Modifier.clickable { tappedWord = token }
    ) {
        Text(
            text = token,
            fontSize = 16.sp,
            color = V2Colors.TextPrimary,
            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 4.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
        )
    }
}
            }
        }

        if (tappedWord != null) {
            val clean = AnswerChecker.normalizeBasic(tappedWord!!)
            val matchedEntity = courseWords.find {
AnswerChecker.normalizeBasic(it.word) == clean || AnswerChecker.normalizeBasic(it.usWord) == clean
            }
            val translation = matchedEntity?.acceptedTranslations(explainLang)?.replace("|", ", ")
?: "слово из текста («$clean»)"

            Surface(
shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
color = V2Colors.PrimaryLight,
border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Primary.copy(alpha = 0.35f)),
modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            ) {
Row(
    modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp),
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
) {
    Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
        Text(clean, fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
        Text("Перевод: $translation", fontSize = 13.sp, color = V2Colors.TextSecondary)
    }
    Button(
        onClick = {
            onAddWordToAnki(clean, translation)
            tappedWord = null
        },
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
        colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = V2Colors.Primary)
    ) {
        Text("В Anki", maxLines = 1, softWrap = false)
    }
}
            }
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 16. ЭКРАНЫ СТАРТОВОГО ТЕСТА, ТЕСТА НЕДЕЛИ И РАЗБОРА ОШИБОК (РАЗДЕЛЫ 9, 10)
// ============================================================================

@Composable
fun PlacementTestScreen(
    session: PlacementTestSession,
    onSubmitAnswer: (String) -> Unit,
    onCancel: () -> Unit
) {
    val q = session.levelQuestions.getOrNull(session.currentIndex) ?: return
    var typedInput by remember(q.id) { mutableStateOf("") }

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .padding(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        Text(
            text = "Стартовый тест • Проверка уровня ${session.currentLevel.code}",
            fontSize = 16.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            color = V2Colors.TextPrimary
        )
        Text(
            text = "Вопрос ${session.currentIndex + 1} из ${session.levelQuestions.size} (для прохождения уровня нужно ≥ 4 из 5)",
            fontSize = 12.sp,
            color = V2Colors.TextSecondary
        )

        QuestionInteractiveCard(
            question = q,
            typedInput = typedInput,
            onTypedChange = { typedInput = it },
            onSelectOrSubmit = { ans -> onSubmitAnswer(ans) }
        )
    }
}

@Composable
fun WeeklyTestScreen(
    session: WeeklyTestSession,
    onSubmitAnswer: (String) -> Unit,
    onPauseAndExit: () -> Unit
) {
    val q = session.questions.getOrNull(session.currentIndex) ?: return
    var typedInput by remember(q.id) { mutableStateOf("") }
    val mins = session.remainingSeconds / 60
    val secs = session.remainingSeconds % 60
    val timeStr = String.format(Locale.US, "%02d:%02d", mins, secs)

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .padding(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Column {
Text(
    text = "Тест недели на уровень ${session.targetLevel}",
    fontSize = 16.sp,
    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
    color = V2Colors.TextPrimary
)
Text(
    text = "Раздел: ${q.section.uppercase()} • Вопрос ${session.currentIndex + 1}/${session.questions.size}",
    fontSize = 12.sp,
    color = V2Colors.TextSecondary
)
            }
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
Surface(shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp), color = V2Colors.GoldLight) {
    Text(
        text = timeStr,
        fontSize = 13.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        color = V2Colors.Gold,
        modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
    )
}
OutlinedButton(onClick = onPauseAndExit, shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp)) {
    Text("Пауза", fontSize = 12.sp)
}
            }
        }

        // Во время теста правила не показываются (Раздел 9)
        QuestionInteractiveCard(
            question = q,
            typedInput = typedInput,
            onTypedChange = { typedInput = it },
            onSelectOrSubmit = { ans -> onSubmitAnswer(ans) }
        )
    }
}

@Composable
fun QuestionInteractiveCard(
    question: TestQuestionData,
    typedInput: String,
    onTypedChange: (String) -> Unit,
    onSelectOrSubmit: (String) -> Unit
) {
    Surface(
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
        color = V2Colors.Surface,
        border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border),
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.padding(18.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
        ) {
            Text(
text = question.question,
fontSize = 16.sp,
fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
color = V2Colors.TextPrimary
            )

            if (question.type == "translate") {
OutlinedTextField(
    value = typedInput,
    onValueChange = onTypedChange,
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
    label = { Text("Введите перевод слова") },
    singleLine = true
)
Button(
    onClick = { if (typedInput.isNotBlank()) onSelectOrSubmit(typedInput) },
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
    shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
    colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = V2Colors.Primary)
) {
    Text("Ответить")
}
            } else {
question.options.forEach { opt ->
    OutlinedButton(
        onClick = { onSelectOrSubmit(opt) },
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)
    ) {
        Text(
            text = opt,
            color = V2Colors.TextPrimary,
            textAlign = TextAlign.Start,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 4.dp)
        )
    }
}
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun ErrorReviewScreen(
    state: ErrorReviewState,
    onDone: () -> Unit
) {
    LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
        contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        item {
            Surface(
shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
color = if (state.passed) V2Colors.PrimaryLight else V2Colors.ErrorLight,
border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (state.passed) V2Colors.Primary else V2Colors.ErrorCoral)
            ) {
Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
    Text(state.title, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
    Text(state.subtitle, fontSize = 13.sp, color = V2Colors.TextSecondary)
    Text(state.nextStepHint, fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
}
            }
        }

        if (state.mistakes.isEmpty()) {
            item {
Text("Ошибок нет — все ответы верные!", fontSize = 14.sp, color = V2Colors.Primary)
            }
        } else {
            item {
Text(
    text = "Разбор ошибок (${state.mistakes.size}):",
    fontSize = 15.sp,
    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
    color = V2Colors.TextPrimary
)
            }
            items(state.mistakes) { m ->
Surface(
    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
    color = V2Colors.Surface,
    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border)
) {
    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
        Text(m.question, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
        Text("Ваш ответ: ${m.userAnswer}", fontSize = 12.sp, color = V2Colors.ErrorCoral)
        Text("Правильно: ${m.correctAnswer}", fontSize = 12.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.Primary)
        if (m.rule.isNotBlank()) {
            Text("Правило: ${m.rule}", fontSize = 12.sp, color = V2Colors.TextSecondary)
        }
    }
}
            }
        }

        item {
            Button(
onClick = onDone,
modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(48.dp),
shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = V2Colors.Primary)
            ) {
Text("Понятно")
            }
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 17. ВКЛАДКА 5: ПРОФИЛЬ (РАЗДЕЛ 12, 13, 16, 17 — КУРСЫ, СЛАБЫЕ ТЕМЫ, МЕДАЛИ, КАЛЕНДАРЬ, БЭКАП)
// ============================================================================

@Composable
fun ProfileTabScreen(
    meta: AppMetaEntity,
    courseStates: List<CourseStateEntity>,
    allWords: List<WordEntity>,
    grammarProgress: List<GrammarProgressEntity>,
    parsedCourses: Map<String, ParsedCourseData>,
    sessions: List<StudySessionEntity>,
    unlockedMedals: List<UnlockedMedalEntity>,
    onPickSafFolder: () -> Unit,
    onActivateInternalStarter: () -> Unit,
    onUpdateCourseSettings: (String, Boolean, Int, String) -> Unit,
    onUpdateGlobalSettings: (String, Boolean, Int) -> Unit,
    onUnlockWeeklyTestNow: (String) -> Unit,
    onBuildBackupJson: suspend () -> String,
    onRestoreBackupJson: (String) -> Unit
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()

    var selectedMedalTab by remember { mutableStateOf("STREAK") } // "STREAK", "TIME", "LEVEL"
    var selectedMedalCourse by remember { mutableStateOf(meta.activeCourseCode) }

    // Разрешение на уведомления для Android 13+ (Раздел 16)
    val notifPermissionLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        contract = ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission()
    ) { granted ->
        if (granted) {
            onUpdateGlobalSettings(meta.englishAccent, true, meta.reminderHour)
        }
    }

    // Системное сохранение файла экспорта backup-ГГГГ-ММ-ДД.json (Раздел 17)
    val exportLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        contract = ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/json")
    ) { uri ->
        if (uri != null) {
            scope.launch {
val json = onBuildBackupJson()
context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri)?.use { out ->
    out.write(json.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
}
            }
        }
    }

    // Системный импорт файла backup-ГГГГ-ММ-ДД.json
    val importLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        contract = ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument()
    ) { uri ->
        if (uri != null) {
            context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use { inp ->
val text = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(inp, Charsets.UTF_8)).readText()
onRestoreBackupJson(text)
            }
        }
    }

    val unlockedIds = remember(unlockedMedals) { unlockedMedals.map { it.medalId }.toSet() }
    val totalAllTimeSeconds = remember(sessions) { sessions.sumOf { it.durationSeconds } }
    val allSkippedLines = remember(parsedCourses) {
        parsedCourses.values.flatMap { it.skippedLinesReport }
    }

    LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
        contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)
    ) {
        // 1. Блок «Курсы»: уровень, часы (равны сумме его сессий), дата следующего теста и прогресс
        item {
            Text("Курсы", fontSize = 17.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
        }

        items(CourseType.entries) { course ->
            val st = courseStates.find { it.courseCode == course.code }
?: CourseStateEntity(courseCode = course.code)
            val courseSec = sessions.filter { it.courseCode == course.code }.sumOf { it.durationSeconds }
            val hoursStr = String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f ч", courseSec / 3600.0)
            val nextLevel = CefrLevel.fromCode(st.currentLevel).nextLevel()?.code ?: "C2"
            val nextLevelWords = allWords.filter { it.courseCode == course.code && it.level == nextLevel }
            val masteredNext = nextLevelWords.count { it.isMastered }
            val progressPct = if (nextLevelWords.isEmpty()) 0 else ((masteredNext.toFloat() / nextLevelWords.size) * 100).roundToInt()
            val nextDate = if (st.nextTestAvailableEpochDay > 0L)
LocalDate.ofEpochDay(st.nextTestAvailableEpochDay).toString()
            else "после старта"

            Surface(
shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
color = V2Colors.Surface,
border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border)
            ) {
Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        Text(course.title, fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
        Surface(shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp), color = V2Colors.PrimaryLight) {
            Text(
                text = "Уровень ${st.currentLevel}",
                fontSize = 12.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                color = V2Colors.Primary,
                modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
            )
        }
    }
    Text(
        text = "Часы: $hoursStr • След. тест: $nextDate • К $nextLevel: $progressPct%",
        fontSize = 12.sp,
        color = V2Colors.TextSecondary
    )
}
            }
        }

        // 2. Слабые темы по каждому курсу (до 10 юнитов и слов, где были ошибки)
        item {
            Surface(
shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
color = V2Colors.Surface,
border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border)
            ) {
Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
    Text("Слабые темы и слова (до 10 на курс)", fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
    CourseType.entries.forEach { course ->
        val weakUnits = grammarProgress
            .filter { it.courseCode == course.code && it.needsRepeat }
            .mapNotNull { gp ->
                parsedCourses[course.code]?.grammarUnits?.find { it.id == gp.unitId }?.title
            }
        val weakWords = allWords
            .filter { it.courseCode == course.code && it.hadMistake && !it.isMastered }
            .map { it.word }
        val combined = (weakUnits + weakWords).take(10)
        if (combined.isNotEmpty()) {
            Text(
                text = "${course.title}: ${combined.joinToString(", ")}",
                fontSize = 12.sp,
                color = V2Colors.ErrorCoral
            )
        }
    }
}
            }
        }

        // 3. Статистика и Календарь активности (28 дней)
        item {
            Surface(
shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
color = V2Colors.Surface,
border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border)
            ) {
Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
    Text("Статистика и календарь активности", fontSize = 15.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
    Text(
        text = "Всего времени: ${String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f ч", totalAllTimeSeconds / 3600.0)} • Стрик: ${meta.currentStreakDays} дн. (рекорд: ${meta.longestStreakDays} дн.)",
        fontSize = 12.sp,
        color = V2Colors.TextSecondary
    )

    val today = LocalDate.now().toEpochDay()
    val daysList = (27 downTo 0).map { today - it }
    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
        for (row in 0 until 4) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
            ) {
                for (col in 0 until 7) {
                    val dayEpoch = daysList[row * 7 + col]
                    val mins = sessions
                        .filter { it.epochDay == dayEpoch && it.courseCode != "ALL_ONLY" }
                        .sumOf { it.durationSeconds } / 60
                    val cellColor = when {
                        mins >= 30 -> V2Colors.Primary
                        mins >= 15 -> V2Colors.Primary.copy(alpha = 0.7f)
                        mins >= 5 -> V2Colors.Primary.copy(alpha = 0.4f)
                        mins > 0 -> V2Colors.PrimaryLight
                        else -> V2Colors.SurfaceSubtle
                    }
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .weight(1f)
                            .height(22.dp)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                            .background(cellColor),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = if (mins > 0) "${mins}м" else "",
                            fontSize = 9.sp,
                            color = if (mins >= 15) Color.White else V2Colors.TextSecondary
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
            }
        }

        // 4. Достижения (Медали стрика общие, медали часов и уровней отдельно по каждому курсу)
        item {
            Text("Достижения и медали", fontSize = 17.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
listOf(
    "STREAK" to "Стрик (Общие)",
    "TIME" to "Часы (По курсу)",
    "LEVEL" to "Уровни (По курсу)"
).forEach { (k, label) ->
    FilterChip(
        selected = selectedMedalTab == k,
        onClick = { selectedMedalTab = k },
        label = { Text(label, fontSize = 11.sp) }
    )
}
            }
            if (selectedMedalTab != "STREAK") {
LazyRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
    items(CourseType.entries) { c ->
        FilterChip(
            selected = selectedMedalCourse == c.code,
            onClick = { selectedMedalCourse = c.code },
            label = { Text(c.title, fontSize = 11.sp) }
        )
    }
}
            }
        }

        val medalsToDisplay = when (selectedMedalTab) {
            "STREAK" -> {
val targets = listOf(7, 14, 21, 28) + (60..360 step 30).toList()
targets.map { d ->
    val id = "MEDAL_STREAK_$d"
    val unlocked = id in unlockedIds || meta.longestStreakDays >= d
    MedalViewItem(
        id = id,
        title = "Стрик $d дней",
        conditionText = "Заниматься без пропусков $d дн. подряд (≥ 5 мин в день)",
        progressText = "${min(meta.longestStreakDays, d)} / $d дн.",
        progressFraction = (meta.longestStreakDays.toFloat() / d).coerceIn(0f, 1f),
        isUnlocked = unlocked,
        category = "STREAK"
    )
}
            }
            "TIME" -> {
val course = CourseType.fromCode(selectedMedalCourse)
val courseHours = sessions.filter { it.courseCode == course.code }.sumOf { it.durationSeconds } / 3600f
