val targets = listOf(1, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000)
targets.map { h ->
    val id = "MEDAL_HOURS_${course.code}_$h"
    val unlocked = id in unlockedIds || courseHours >= h
    val title = if (h == 1) "${course.shortCode}: 1 час (Новичок)" else "${course.shortCode}: $h часов"
    MedalViewItem(
        id = id,
        title = title,
        conditionText = "Набрать $h ч активных занятий в курсе ${course.title}",
        progressText = String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f / %d ч", min(courseHours, h.toFloat()), h),
        progressFraction = (courseHours / h.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f),
        isUnlocked = unlocked,
        category = "TIME"
    )
}
            }
            else -> {
val course = CourseType.fromCode(selectedMedalCourse)
val st = courseStates.find { it.courseCode == course.code }
val curIdx = CefrLevel.fromCode(st?.currentLevel ?: "A0").orderIndex
// Уровни A1..C2 отдельно для каждого курса; для A0 медали нет (Раздел 13)
CefrLevel.entries.filter { it != CefrLevel.A0 }.map { lvl ->
    val id = "MEDAL_LVL_${course.code}_${lvl.code}"
    val unlocked = id in unlockedIds || curIdx >= lvl.orderIndex
    MedalViewItem(
        id = id,
        title = "${course.title} • Уровень ${lvl.code}",
        conditionText = "Пройти тест на уровень ${lvl.code} в курсе ${course.title}",
        progressText = if (unlocked) "Открыто" else "Текущий: ${st?.currentLevel ?: "A0"}",
        progressFraction = if (unlocked) 1f else 0f,
        isUnlocked = unlocked,
        category = "LEVEL"
    )
}
            }
        }

        items(medalsToDisplay, key = { it.id }) { m ->
            Surface(
shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp),
color = V2Colors.Surface,
border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (m.isUnlocked) V2Colors.Gold else V2Colors.Border)
            ) {
Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(14.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        Row(
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
        ) {
            Surface(
                shape = CircleShape,
                color = if (m.isUnlocked) V2Colors.GoldLight else V2Colors.SurfaceSubtle
            ) {
                Icon(
                    imageVector = if (m.isUnlocked) Icons.Default.WorkspacePremium else Icons.Outlined.Lock,
                    contentDescription = null,
                    tint = if (m.isUnlocked) V2Colors.Gold else V2Colors.TextMuted,
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(8.dp).size(20.dp)
                )
            }
            Column {
                Text(m.title, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = V2Colors.TextPrimary)
                Text(m.conditionText, fontSize = 12.sp, color = V2Colors.TextSecondary)
            }
        }
        Text(
            text = m.progressText,
            fontSize = 11.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
            color = if (m.isUnlocked) V2Colors.Gold else V2Colors.TextSecondary,
            maxLines = 1,
            softWrap = false
        )
    }
    LinearProgressIndicator(
        progress = { m.progressFraction },
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(5.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(3.dp)),
        color = if (m.isUnlocked) V2Colors.Gold else V2Colors.Primary,
        trackColor = V2Colors.SurfaceSubtle
    )
}
            }
        }

        // 5. Настройки, папка данных, экспорт и импорт (Разделы 12, 14, 16, 17)
        item {
            Surface(
shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
color = V2Colors.Surface,
border = BorderStroke(1.dp, V2Colors.Border)
            ) {
Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
    Text("Настройки и данные", fontSize = 16.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)

    // Папка данных
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
    ) {
        Button(
            onClick = onPickSafFolder,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
            colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = V2Colors.Primary)
        ) {
            Text("Папка данных (SAF)", fontSize = 12.sp)
        }
        OutlinedButton(
            onClick = onActivateInternalStarter,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp)
        ) {
            Text("Заготовки v2", fontSize = 12.sp)
        }
    }

    if (allSkippedLines.isNotEmpty()) {
        Text(
            text = "Пропущенные некорректные строки:\n" + allSkippedLines.joinToString("\n"),
            fontSize = 11.sp,
            color = V2Colors.ErrorCoral
        )
    }

    Divider(color = V2Colors.Border)

    // Озвучка английского (UK / US) и вечернее напоминание
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        Text("Озвучка и вариант English:", fontSize = 13.sp)
        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
            listOf("UK", "US").forEach { acc ->
                FilterChip(
                    selected = meta.englishAccent == acc,
                    onClick = { onUpdateGlobalSettings(acc, meta.remindersEnabled, meta.reminderHour) },
                    label = { Text(acc) }
                )
            }
        }
    }

    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        Text("Вечернее напоминание (${meta.reminderHour}:00):", fontSize = 13.sp)
        Switch(
            checked = meta.remindersEnabled,
            onCheckedChange = { wantEnable ->
                if (wantEnable && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
                    val granted = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
                        context,
                        Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
                    ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
                    if (!granted) {
                        notifPermissionLauncher.launch(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
                        return@Switch
                    }
                }
                onUpdateGlobalSettings(meta.englishAccent, wantEnable, meta.reminderHour)
            }
        )
    }

    Divider(color = V2Colors.Border)

    // Настройки по каждому курсу: включение, лимит новых слов (0..30), язык объяснений
    Text("Лимиты новых слов (0–30) и курсы:", fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
    CourseType.entries.forEach { course ->
        val st = courseStates.find { it.courseCode == course.code }
            ?: CourseStateEntity(courseCode = course.code, explainLang = course.defaultExplainLang)
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .background(V2Colors.SurfaceSubtle, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                .padding(10.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
        ) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Checkbox(
                        checked = st.enabled,
                        onCheckedChange = {
                            onUpdateCourseSettings(course.code, it, st.dailyNewLimit, st.explainLang)
                        }
                    )
                    Text(course.title, fontSize = 14.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold)
                }
                TextButton(onClick = { onUnlockWeeklyTestNow(course.code) }) {
                    Text("Открыть тест", fontSize = 11.sp)
                }
            }
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Text("Новых слов в день: ${st.dailyNewLimit}", fontSize = 12.sp)
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
                    listOf(0, 5, 10, 20, 30).forEach { lim ->
                        AssistChip(
                            onClick = {
                                onUpdateCourseSettings(course.code, st.enabled, lim, st.explainLang)
                            },
                            label = { Text("$lim", fontSize = 11.sp) }
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Text("Язык переводов/объяснений:", fontSize = 12.sp)
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                    listOf("ru" to "RU", "en" to "EN").forEach { (code, lbl) ->
                        FilterChip(
                            selected = st.explainLang == code,
                            onClick = {
                                onUpdateCourseSettings(course.code, st.enabled, st.dailyNewLimit, code)
                            },
                            label = { Text(lbl, fontSize = 11.sp) }
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Divider(color = V2Colors.Border)

    // Экспорт и импорт прогресса backup-ГГГГ-ММ-ДД.json (Раздел 17)
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
    ) {
        Button(
            onClick = {
                val dateStr = LocalDate.now().toString()
                exportLauncher.launch("backup-$dateStr.json")
            },
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
            colors = ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(containerColor = V2Colors.AccentBlue)
        ) {
            Text("Экспорт JSON", fontSize = 12.sp)
        }
        OutlinedButton(
            onClick = { importLauncher.launch(arrayOf("application/json", "text/plain", "*/*")) },
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp)
        ) {
            Text("Импорт JSON", fontSize = 12.sp)
        }
    }
}
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun LevelFilterRow(
    selectedLevel: String?,
    onSelectLevel: (String?) -> Unit
) {
    LazyRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
        item {
            FilterChip(
selected = selectedLevel == null,
onClick = { onSelectLevel(null) },
label = { Text("Все уровни", fontSize = 12.sp) }
            )
        }
        items(CefrLevel.entries) { lvl ->
            FilterChip(
selected = selectedLevel == lvl.code,
onClick = { onSelectLevel(lvl.code) },
label = { Text(lvl.code, fontSize = 12.sp) }
            )
        }
    }
}
